title: Junior Creative Strategist for Meta Ads | Retainer + % on Winning Ads + Equity Opportunity!
description:
We are not looking for someone who can generate 50 generic AI hooks.



We are looking for someone who can find the one idea strong enough to carry an entire ad campaign.



We operate a growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands and are looking for a Junior Creative Strategist who understands direct-response marketing, persuasive copywriting, and the importance of deep manual research.



This is an ongoing position with a fixed retainer, performance bonuses, and significant long-term growth potential. Exceptional performers may eventually have the opportunity to become a Creative Director, lead a brand, or participate in the ownership of one of our brands.



THE ROLE



Your job will be to research, develop, and manage new advertising concepts for
 and Instagram.



We believe that approximately 80% of creative strategy is research and 20% is execution. If the underlying concept is strong enough, most of the difficult work has already been done.



Your research may include:



* Successful competitor advertisements

* Viral organic videos

* TikTok and Instagram content

* Reddit posts and personal stories

* Customer reviews and comments

* Forums and online communities

* Emotional stories, frustrations, desires, and transformations

* Anything else that reveals what genuinely moves a particular audience



AI can assist with organizing information, but it cannot replace genuine manual research. We need someone willing to do the detailed and sometimes repetitive work required to uncover exceptional ideas.



YOUR WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES



Each week, you will:



1. Research and present approximately 20-25 strong advertising concepts.



2. Clearly explain the following for every concept:



* The target customer or avatar

* The central problem, desire, or emotion

* The relevant product USP

* The proposed advertising angle

* The source or inspiration

* Why you believe the concept could perform



3. Receive feedback on which concepts are approved or rejected.



4. Turn approximately 10-15 approved concepts into production-ready creative batches.



5. Write complete direct-response scripts for the approved concepts.



6. Provide strong hooks, reference clips, context, and clear instructions for our video editors.



7. Follow up with the editors and ensure that all assigned creatives are completed on time.



Our editors will handle the actual video production. Your responsibility is the idea, angle, research, copy, script, creative direction, and timely handoff.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should:



* Have experience writing scripts for Meta/Facebook advertisements

* Understand direct-response copywriting

* Know how to research audiences deeply

* Understand why different customer avatars respond to different USPs

* Be able to identify emotional stories and turn them into advertising concepts

* Understand hooks, awareness levels, objections, desires, and buying motivations

* Be comfortable creating bold, high-conviction marketing angles

* Know how to use strong and specific claims when they can be properly supported

* Understand that generic and overly safe advertising rarely wins competitive
 auctions

* Be highly organized and dependable with deadlines

* Be able to communicate clearly with video editors

* Have excellent written English

* Be open to direct feedback and frequent testing



You do not need ten years of experience. However, you must demonstrate strong research instincts, persuasive writing ability, and a genuine understanding of direct-response marketing.



This is not primarily a graphic design, video editing, or media buying position. It is a research, copywriting, and creative strategy position.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



The compensation structure includes:



* A fixed ongoing retainer

* An additional bonus based on the advertising spend generated by your creatives

* Access to our internal spend-tracking system



Our tracking system allows strategists to see exactly how much advertising spend their creatives generate. You will be able to monitor your results and corresponding bonus in real time.



For the right person, this can become much more than a standard freelance position.



Strong long-term performers may receive:



* Increased responsibility

* Higher compensation

* Creative Director opportunities

* The opportunity to lead a brand

* Potential equity or partial ownership opportunities under a separate agreement



INITIAL TRIAL



The position will begin with a paid two-week trial.



During the trial, we will primarily evaluate:



* The quality and depth of your research

* Your ability to identify promising concepts

* Your understanding of different avatars and USPs

* Your direct-response writing

* Your ability to turn research into clear, production-ready scripts

* Your reliability and communication



If the trial is successful, we would like to continue working together on an ongoing basis.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your proposal with the words “RESEARCH FIRST” so we know you read the complete job post.



Please also answer the following questions:



1. What experience do you have with direct-response advertising and Meta ad scripts?



2. Please share examples of scripts, concepts, or advertisements you have worked on. Include results where possible.



3. How do you normally research new advertising concepts?



4. Tell us about one advertising concept you discovered through manual research and explain why you believed it could work.



5. How do you determine which USP to use for a specific customer avatar?



6. What is your availability, and what fixed monthly retainer would you expect?



We are looking for someone ambitious who wants to become an exceptional creative strategist, not someone looking to complete only the minimum number of assigned tasks.

title: Virtual Assistant / Content Quality Manager – YouTube Stories/Mysteries Channel
description:
Virtual Assistant / Content Quality Manager – YouTube Stories/Mysteries Channel



We are looking for a highly detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who can grow into the Content Quality Manager of our documentary-style YouTube channel featuring a real, human host.



Our content focuses on political and family scandals like the JFK-Lewinsky affair, and famous mysteries such as Jack the Ripper.

The channel is still relatively new, but one of our first videos has already surpassed 500,000 views. We have ambitious long-term plans and are looking for someone who genuinely wants to help us build something exceptional.



Our mission is to build a high-quality, human-led storytelling channel, with a strong and warm community, in a world increasingly filled with mass-produced and AI-generated content. We are looking for someone who genuinely wants to help us build that.



Your role



You will initially join as a Virtual Assistant, learning our channel, workflow, quality standards, and production process.

Over time, we want to train you to become the manager who has complete oversight of the production process — from research and scriptwriting to recording, editing, quality control, to even publishing, overseeing future livestreams, etc.

You will essentially become the person who always has the overview and makes sure every project moves forward while meeting our quality standards.



This responsibility is extremely important.



What we're looking for

You need to genuinely care about quality and have an exceptional eye for detail.

Ideally, you already have experience with content quality control, content production, or managing/overseeing a YouTube channel.



You should:

• Have an extremely strong eye for detail and immediately notice when something feels wrong

• Review research, scripts, edits, and final videos for quality

• Understand what makes a great YouTube video and what keeps viewers watching

• Understand the importance of a powerful intro and hook

• Know that the first 5 seconds, first minute, and first 5 minutes are each crucial for audience retention in different ways

• Understand storytelling, pacing, curiosity, and viewer retention

• Be extremely strong at fact-checking and verifying information

• Make sure names, dates, footage, photographs, claims, quotes, and other details are accurate

• Catch mistakes before a video is published

• Give clear and actionable feedback to writers, editors, and other team members

• You are also open to feedback yourself. You understand no video is perfect, and there will always be improvements. 

• Keep an overview of deadlines, revisions, and the complete production pipeline

• Communicate quickly and proactively

• Never settle for "good enough" when something can clearly be improved



Accuracy is especially important. These are real stories about real people and historical events. We want every video to be properly researched and fact-checked, and we expect you to take responsibility for identifying errors before they reach the viewer.

Compensation & growth



This position is designed to grow together with your responsibilities.

• Training phase: $40–50 per completed video project. You will learn our workflow and quality standards while I remain closely involved. 

• Junior Quality Control: $60–75 per project once you can independently review scripts, research, fact-checking, and video edits, with me primarily doing the final check. 

• Content Quality Manager: $80–120 per project once you can take real ownership of the quality-control process and independently identify and solve problems before projects reach me. 

• Long-term management role: As your responsibilities grow beyond individual projects and you begin overseeing the broader production process, we can transition to an hourly rate or fixed monthly compensation. 

A full project can involve approximately 10–15 hours of work, especially during the learning stages. Quality is much more important to us than rushing through a checklist.



Our mission



YouTube is increasingly filled with mass-produced content, AI-generated voices, and artificial characters. While AI is great and it helps many creators, there is also a very large group of people who long for something different: something completely human. 

We want to build something different: a high-quality storytelling channel centered around a real host and even multiple hosts in the future, whom viewers can connect with over the long term.

We want to create genuinely enjoyable, well-researched stories and gradually build a really big community around the channel. We interact with the viewers. `



We're looking for someone who genuinely cares about that mission and wants to give their true best to help us achieve it.

There are many exciting plans for this channel, and for the right person, this can grow into an important long-term management position with many growth options both in responsibility and salary.



If you are highly organized, extremely detail-oriented, passionate about YouTube and storytelling, and genuinely care about producing exceptional content, please apply and tell us about your relevant experience.

title: Video Editor for Ecommerce (Meta Ads Specialist)
description:
We are looking for a full-time Video Editor specialized in ecommerce, short-form organic content and Meta Ads to join our team long-term.



Your role will be to turn raw UGC, product footage and existing assets into high-performing TikTok/Reels organic content and Meta Ads.



Our approach is simple: organic content is the creative engine for our paid ads. We continuously test hooks, angles, formats and concepts organically, then turn the strongest ideas into paid creatives and iterate based on performance data.



What you'll do:



Edit TikTok/Reels organic content and Meta Ads

Turn the same raw footage into multiple creative concepts

Create strong hooks and engaging first 1–3 seconds

Edit UGC, product demos, testimonials, voiceovers and direct-response ads

Create new variations of winning creatives

Study trends, competitors and winning ads for new ideas

Use performance data to improve future creatives



We are not looking for a cinematic editor. We want someone who understands ecommerce, attention, hooks, pacing, storytelling and performance-driven content.



Availability & Commitment: This is a full-time position (40h/week), 5 days/week. We are looking for a long-term team member who will make our company their primary professional commitment, not a freelancer managing 5–6 clients at the same time. Occasional weekend availability may be required for genuine emergencies or important launches.



Requirements:



Experience with ecommerce / UGC video editing

Strong understanding of TikTok, Reels and Meta Ads

Fast editing and ability to produce multiple variations

Performance and direct-response mindset

Reliable, proactive and able to work independently



Please apply with your best ecommerce organic videos + Meta Ads portfolio.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid editing test using our raw footage.

title: Listing & Transaction Coordinator for Real Estate Team
description:
The  Listing Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting a fast-paced, high-performing Large real estate Team ( 15 Agents ) by managing the listing lifecycle from listing preparation, signing and activating the listing, through the marketing cycle to an accepted contract. While maintaining the integrity of the team's CRM and transaction management systems. This position serves as the primary administrative liaison between sellers & agents, ensuring every listing is processed accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional client service. You will be managing over 100 Listings. This is a fast paced high volume position. Long term opportunity. Even though this is a Listing focused position, the Transaction Coordinator will assist with buy side Pre Contract functions such as Offer preparation thru the lifecycle of Executed contract.  



The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple deadlines while maintaining a superior client experience.



## Key Responsibilities



### Listing Management & Coordination



* Prepare and distribute listing agreements and associated listing documentation.

* Verify accuracy of listing terms including pricing, commissions, listing periods, and required disclosures.

* Coordinate execution of all listing documents and ensure all signatures, initials, and required fields are completed.

* Communicate with sellers via phone, text,
, and electronic signature platforms.

* Explain listing procedures and next steps to clients.

* Manage seller homework packages including disclosures, property information forms, surveys, rental schedules, and additional required documentation.

* Coordinate professional photography, scheduling, vendor communication, and follow-up.



### MLS & Marketing Administration



* Prepare and enter listings into MLS systems.

* Verify listing accuracy, remarks, property details, supplements, and compliance requirements.

* Upload and manage listing photos and marketing assets.

* Coordinate seller activity reporting through 
, Zillow, Boldtrail, Followup Boss and other marketing platforms.

* Configure and maintain ShowingTime settings, showing instructions, and access information.

* Manage open house tracking systems and listing promotion tools.



### CRM & Database Management



* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records within CRM, transaction management, and brokerage systems.

* Enter and update seller information, listing details, commission structures, lead sources, and property notes.

* Create and manage automated reminders, follow-up tasks, and listing expiration alerts.

* Monitor database integrity and ensure all client records remain current and complete.

* Track seller communication, outstanding documentation, and listing milestones.

* Generate reports and provide updates to team leadership regarding listing status and CRM performance.



### Compliance & Transaction Oversight



* Maintain compliance with brokerage policies and state real estate regulations.

* Submit listing files for broker review and approval.

* Conduct regular file audits to ensure required documentation is complete and properly organized.

* Resolve missing documentation and compliance deficiencies.

* Monitor listing expiration dates and coordinate extensions, renewals, or cancellations as needed.

* Ensure all transaction records are organized, accessible, and audit-ready.



### Vendor & Team Coordination



* Coordinate with photographers, marketing vendors, transaction management personnel, and brokerage staff.

* Communicate listing updates to agents, team members, and administrative staff.

* Track photography invoices and coordinate payment processing.

* Maintain relationships with vendors and ensure timely completion of services.



### Client Experience Management



* Deliver a high level of customer service throughout the listing process.

* Provide consistent communication and updates to sellers and agents.

* Anticipate client needs and proactively resolve issues.

* Ensure every seller receives a smooth, professional, and organized listing experience.



---



## Qualifications



### Required



* Administrative, transaction coordination, listing coordination, or real estate operations experience.

* Strong knowledge of residential real estate transactions.

* Experience with MLS systems and transaction management platforms.

* Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

* Strong written and verbal communication abilities.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

* High attention to detail and accuracy.



### Preferred



* Experience with  Transaction management systems

* CRM management experience within a real estate environment.

* Knowledge of brokerage compliance requirements.

* Experience supporting a high-volume real estate team.



## Core Competencies



* Client Service Excellence

* Organization & Time Management

* Communication & Relationship Building

* Attention to Detail

* Problem Solving

* Process Management

* Technology Proficiency

* Compliance Awareness

* Multitasking

* Team Collaboration



---



## Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by:



* Accurate and timely listing onboarding.

* Compliance audit completion and file accuracy.

* CRM data integrity and maintenance.

* Seller satisfaction and communication standards.

* Listing activation timelines.

* Reduction of documentation errors and compliance issues.

* Effective management of listing expirations and renewals.

* Consistent support of agents and team operations.



This position is essential to maintaining operational excellence, delivering exceptional client service, and ensuring the successful execution of every listing from contract to market.



NOTE: This position will NOT be doing TC services from Accepted OFFER  - Contract to Closing. Only TC services from Listing preparation to MLS to Marketing to Accepted OFFER.

title: AI, Automation & Marketing Operations Assistant
description:
We’re looking for a highly resourceful AI, Automation & Marketing Operations Assistant to work directly with the founder of RevLoft.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role.



You’ll act as the founder’s right hand across client fulfillment, internal operations, marketing, content, automation, and other day-to-day priorities. Your primary strength should be building automations, but you should also be comfortable learning new tools and handling a wide variety of marketing-related tasks.



You do not need to be world-class at everything (we will give you all SOPs and training needed to perform like an A player). However, you must be technically capable, dependable, fast at learning, and able to figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions for every task.



About RevLoft:



RevLoft is a marketing agency that builds webinar and VSL funnels for information businesses. We help clients with funnel strategy, copywriting, automation, advertising, and marketing operations.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Automation and AI:



* Building and maintaining automations using tools such as GoHighLevel, n8n, Make, or Zapier

* Connecting forms, calendars, CRMs,
 platforms, Slack, and other software

* Working with webhooks, APIs, filters, conditional logic, and data mapping

* Troubleshooting broken workflows and finding the source of errors

* Using AI tools to make internal and client processes faster

* Researching and implementing new tools when required

* Testing automations thoroughly before they go live



Marketing and Operations:



* Helping build and test webinar, VSL, lead-generation, and appointment-booking funnels

* Creating and updating CRM pipelines, workflows, tags, forms, and campaigns

* Testing pages, forms,
s, calendars, tracking, and automations before launch

* Publishing and scheduling content across social media platforms

* Assisting with lead generation and outreach campaigns

* Organizing project information, documenting processes, and creating SOPs

* Following up with team members and helping keep projects on schedule

* Handling miscellaneous operational tasks as priorities change



Design and Content Support:



* Creating clean social media graphics, presentations, documents, and simple marketing assets in Canva

* Using AI tools to create or improve visual assets

* Making basic design decisions without requiring constant direction

* Uploading, formatting, and publishing content accurately



Note that these are NOT daily responsibilities, daily responsibilites vary from day to day. 



You’re a Good Fit If You:



* Have previous experience building marketing automations

* Understand how funnels, CRMs,
 marketing, and lead generation work

* Are comfortable using GoHighLevel and at least one automation platform such as n8n, Make, or Zapier

* Can use Canva (or similar tool) and have a decent eye for clean, professional design

* Regularly use AI tools for research, writing, problem-solving, or automation

* Have strong written English and communicate clearly

* Pay close attention to small details

* Can follow instructions but do not depend on instructions for every decision

* Take ownership of problems and follow them through until they are solved

* Learn unfamiliar software quickly

* Communicate early when something is delayed or unclear

* Are comfortable working directly with a fast-moving founder



You’re Not a Good Fit If You:



* Need every task explained through a detailed tutorial

* Say you understand something when you do not

* Submit work without testing or checking it

* Frequently miss deadlines without communicating

* Wait for follow-ups before completing assigned work

* Only have experience with basic administrative VA tasks

* Claim to know every tool but cannot explain what you have actually built



Role Details



* Part-time position

* Approximately 20 hours per week

* Remote

* Opportunity for increased hours and responsibility based on performance

* Some overlap with GMT +5 timezone will be required



How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience

2. Examples of automations you have personally built

3. The tools you have used, including your experience level with each

4. Examples of Canva designs or other marketing assets you have created (if any)

5. Your current availability and expected compensation per month



We are a growing company and as we grow, your compensation will grow as well.

title: Experienced Native-Style Static Ad Strategist for Meta Ads - Retainer, Performance Bonus and Equity Opportunity
description:
We are not looking for someone who places a product image beside three generic benefit icons and calls it a
 ad.



We are looking for someone who understands how to make a static ad feel native to the feed while still selling with clarity and conviction.



We operate a growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands and are looking for an experienced Native-Style Static Ad Strategist with a strong understanding of direct-response marketing, persuasive copywriting, manual research, and visual communication.



This is not an entry-level role. You must already have hands-on experience developing native-style static advertisements for
 and Instagram.



This is an ongoing position with a fixed retainer, performance bonuses, and significant long-term growth potential. Exceptional performers may eventually have the opportunity to become a Creative Director, lead a brand, or participate in the ownership of one of our brands.



WHAT WE MEAN BY NATIVE-STYLE STATIC ADS



We are referring to static Meta advertisements that feel natural inside the
 or Instagram feed instead of looking like polished corporate advertisements.



These may include:



* Real customer story and testimonial creatives

* Review and comment-based advertisements

* Social media post formats

* Reddit and forum-inspired formats

* Text message and conversation formats

* Founder notes and personal stories

* Editorial and article-inspired layouts

* Comparison and list-style advertisements

* Memes and culturally relevant formats

* Raw customer or product photography

* Product demonstrations communicated in a single image

* Other simple and believable formats that make people stop and read



We are not referring to media buying on native advertising networks such as Taboola or Outbrain.



THE ROLE



Your job will be to research, develop, create, and manage new native-style static advertising concepts for
 and Instagram.



We believe the best static ads are discovered before they are designed.



The final image may look simple, but the research, customer insight, hook, angle, copy, format, and visual hierarchy behind it must be exceptional.



Approximately 80 percent of this role is research and strategic thinking. The remaining 20 percent is turning that research into clear and compelling static advertisements.



Your research may include:



* Successful competitor static advertisements

* Meta Ad Library research

* Viral organic posts and social media content

* Reddit posts and personal stories

* Customer reviews and comments

* Forums and online communities

* Advertorials and editorial content

* Memes and emerging native content formats

* Emotional stories, frustrations, desires, objections, and transformations

* Successful video concepts that could be communicated in a single image

* Anything else that reveals what genuinely moves a particular audience



AI can assist with organizing information and exploring variations, but it cannot replace genuine manual research.



We do not need 50 slightly different headlines generated from the same prompt. We need someone who can uncover an original insight and turn it into a static concept strong enough to carry an entire advertising campaign.



YOUR WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES



Each week, you will:



1. Research and present approximately 20 to 25 strong native-style static advertising concepts.



These should be genuinely different concepts, not minor headline or layout variations.



2. Clearly explain the following for every concept:



* The target customer or avatar

* The customer's awareness level

* The central problem, desire, objection, or emotion

* The relevant product USP or proof point

* The proposed advertising angle

* The native format you recommend

* The proposed hook or central message

* The source or inspiration

* Why you believe the concept could perform



3. Receive direct feedback on which concepts are approved or rejected.



4. Turn approximately 10 to 15 approved concepts into production-ready static creative batches.



5. Write all necessary copy, including:



* On-image copy

* Headlines

* Subheadlines

* Calls to action where appropriate

* Supporting Meta headlines and primary text when required



6. Provide visual references, image direction, rough mockups, layout guidance, and clear instructions for our graphic designers.



7. Create deliberate variations that test meaningful elements such as:



* Hooks

* Customer avatars

* USPs

* Proof elements

* Images

* Native formats

* Visual hierarchy



8. Follow up with our designers and ensure that all assigned creatives are completed correctly and on time.



9. Review creative performance, identify why certain ads are winning or losing, and develop intelligent iterations based on the data.



Our designers can support final production and polishing. However, you must be capable of communicating your ideas visually and creating clear rough mockups in tools such as Canva or Figma.



Your responsibility is the research, big idea, angle, copy, native format, visual direction, production brief, iteration strategy, and timely handoff.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should:



* Have proven experience developing native-style static Meta advertisements

* Be able to show real examples of native static ads you have worked on

* Understand direct-response marketing for DTC e-commerce brands

* Understand why native-looking creatives can outperform polished brand advertisements

* Know how to conduct deep manual customer and competitor research

* Be able to turn customer insights into compelling single-image advertisements

* Understand hooks, awareness levels, objections, desires, and buying motivations

* Understand how different customer avatars respond to different USPs

* Have strong direct-response copywriting skills

* Understand mobile-first visual hierarchy and readability

* Know how to match the creative format to the angle and customer

* Be able to develop meaningful variations without simply changing colors or individual words

* Understand metrics such as spend, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS

* Be able to use performance data to develop stronger iterations

* Be comfortable creating bold and high-conviction marketing angles

* Know how to use strong and specific claims when they can be properly supported

* Understand that generic and overly safe advertising rarely wins competitive
 auctions

* Be able to create clear briefs and communicate effectively with graphic designers

* Be highly organized and dependable with deadlines

* Have excellent written English

* Be open to direct feedback and frequent testing



You do not need ten years of experience. However, you must demonstrate genuine hands-on experience with native-style static Meta ads and a strong understanding of why they work.



Experience limited to polished social media graphics, display banners, Amazon listing images, or generic AI-generated advertisements is not sufficient for this position.



This is not primarily a conventional graphic design, video editing, or media buying position. It is a research, copywriting, native-format concept development, and static creative strategy position.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



The compensation structure includes:



* A fixed ongoing retainer

* An additional bonus based on the advertising spend generated by your creatives

* Access to our internal spend-tracking system



Our tracking system allows strategists to see exactly how much advertising spend their creatives generate. You will be able to monitor your results and corresponding bonus in real time.



For the right person, this can become much more than a standard freelance position.



Strong long-term performers may receive:



* Increased responsibility

* Higher compensation

* Creative Director opportunities

* The opportunity to lead a brand

* Potential equity or partial ownership opportunities under a separate agreement



INITIAL TRIAL



The position will begin with a paid two-week trial.



During the trial, we will primarily evaluate:



* The quality and depth of your manual research

* Your understanding of native-style static advertising

* The originality and strength of your concepts

* Your ability to match avatars, USPs, angles, and native formats

* Your direct-response copywriting

* Your visual judgment and creative direction

* The clarity of your mockups and production briefs

* Your ability to create intelligent variations

* Your response to feedback

* Your reliability and communication



If the trial is successful, we would like to continue working together on an ongoing basis.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your proposal with the words "STATIC FIRST" so we know you read the complete job post.



Please also answer the following questions:



1. What experience do you have creating native-style static advertisements for Meta and
?



2. Please share your strongest native static ad examples. For each example, explain exactly what you were responsible for and include results, ROAS, CPA, or advertising spend where possible.



3. Choose one static ad from your portfolio and explain the target customer, USP, angle, native format, and why you believe the ad worked.



4. How do you normally research new native static advertising concepts?



5. How do you use performance data to develop new variations of a winning static ad?



6. What is your availability, and what fixed monthly retainer would you expect?



Please do not send only a general design portfolio. We specifically want to see direct-response, native-style static
 advertisements.



We are looking for someone ambitious who wants to become exceptional at native static advertising, not someone looking to make generic Canva graphics or complete only the minimum number of assigned tasks.

We’re looking for a Customer Service Representative who will take full responsibility for handling customer inquiries, exchanges, and returns for our E-commerce fashion dropshipping stores.

You’ll be part of a dedicated customer service team, working closely with other representatives and a manager to ensure that as much revenue as possible is driven and retained through customer service.



We’re not looking for someone who just “replies to emails.” We’re looking for someone who thinks and acts like an A-player: disciplined, proactive, and committed to excellence.

You communicate with empathy, and take ownership of every situation. You always look for solutions instead of excuses and understand that every interaction is a chance to create value for both the customer and the company.



You must already have experience in customer service for Shopify fashion dropshipping stores, and know how to communicate effectively, handle returns and exchanges, and solve problems efficiently, keeping customers happy while protecting company profits.

You should know how to use Shopify and ParcelPanel, maintain a professional and calm tone under pressure, and be able to work according to the New York (US) timezone, since most of our customer interactions follow that schedule.

Experience with return funnels and ChatGPT for communication improvement is a must.



You’ll handle emails, refunds, replacements, and order inquiries together with other team members, ensuring a fast, professional, and solution-oriented customer experience every day.

We value people who are organized, reliable, and detail-oriented, who identify problems before they escalate, and who constantly aim to improve how things are done.



You understand that great customer service doesn’t just solve issues. It drives revenue and keeps profits within the company.



This is a position for someone who takes pride in delivering world-class service and wants to be part of a high-performing, professional team.



Please answer these questions in your application:

1. What is your experience with customer service for Shopify fashion dropshipping stores, and for how long?

2. Have you worked for other fashion dropshipping stores before? If yes, which ones?

3. What are your main strengths, and how can you make the company better? What knowledge or ideas can you bring?

6. Do you speak and write English fluently?

7. Are you currently working for another company?

8. How many hours and days per week are you available? Are you also available during weekends?

9. Can you work according to the New York (US) timezone?

title: SYSTEMS INTEGRATION AND AUTOMATION SPECIALIST
description:
We are looking for a highly capable and hands-on Systems Integration & Automation Specialist to manage and maintain our business systems and integrations.



The role will focus on Zendesk, ERP systems, Maropost, Cresco, Shopify, eBay, Amazon and other sales platforms, ensuring that our systems communicate correctly and that integration issues are identified and resolved quickly.



We are looking for someone who can troubleshoot problems independently, understand APIs and system integrations, and work with external software providers or developers when necessary.



Key Responsibilities



* Set up, configure and maintain Zendesk

* Manage Zendesk triggers, automations, workflows, macros and integrations

* Maintain integrations between Zendesk, Shopify, ERP and other business systems

* Manage Maropost System

* Maintain and troubleshoot API integrations, webhooks and data synchronisation

* Support integrations with Shopify, eBay, Amazon and other sales channels

* Investigate and resolve system errors, API errors and data-sync issues

* Monitor integrations and identify potential problems before they affect business operations

* Work with third-party software providers and developers to resolve technical issues

* Manage API credentials, authentication and integration settings

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive business processes

* Use tools such as Postman, Zapier, Make or similar automation platforms

* Document system configurations, integrations and troubleshooting procedures

* Provide general technical support for our business systems



Requirements



* 3+ years of experience in systems administration, systems integration, SaaS administration or a similar role

* Strong experience with API integrations and troubleshooting

* Good understanding of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks and API authentication

* Experience with Zendesk

* Experience with Maropost System

* Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms

* Experience working with ERP systems and/or marketplace integrations

* Familiarity with eBay, Amazon or other online marketplaces

* Experience using Postman or similar API testing tools

* Basic knowledge of JavaScript, Python or another programming language is an advantage

* Experience with Zapier, Make or similar automation tools is an advantage

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

* Good written and spoken English

* Able to work independently and take ownership of technical issues

title: Shopify Web Developer Expert(min. 5 yrs experience required, Work From Home)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Starbond is looking for a full-time Shopify Developer to own the development, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of our Shopify storefront.



This is a Shopify-specialist role. General web-development experience alone does not qualify. We are looking for someone who has already built, modified, debugged, and maintained real Shopify stores and can show us exactly what they personally contributed.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Develop, maintain, and improve Starbond’s Shopify storefront.

Customize Shopify themes, sections, templates, landing pages, product pages, and storefront components.

Write clean, maintainable Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Diagnose and resolve Shopify bugs, broken functionality, layout issues, and integration conflicts.

Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Shopify apps and approved integrations.

Translate Figma/design files into responsive, functional Shopify pages.

Test changes before release and check for downstream issues across devices and browsers.

Maintain safe theme/version-control practices and appropriate rollback paths.

Improve site speed, stability, usability, and technical performance.

Keep assigned tasks, blockers, status, and technical documentation current.

Own work through full completion rather than waiting for repeated follow-up.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Substantial professional Shopify development experience required; 4+ years strongly preferred. Equivalent depth may be considered when demonstrated through complex live-store work and technical assessment.

Strong hands-on proficiency with Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Proven experience customizing and maintaining Shopify themes.

Experience with Shopify apps and integrations.

Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills.

Experience building responsive Shopify storefront experiences.

Ability to implement approved designs from Figma.

Understanding of safe theme/version management and release practices.

Portfolio with verifiable Shopify examples required.



HOW YOU WORK MATTERS

Technical ability is only part of the role. We also need someone who:

Follows through without repeated reminders.

Communicates blockers and risks early.

Tests work before handing it off.

Solves the full problem instead of only the easiest visible part.

Keeps tasks and progress visible.

Takes ownership of mistakes and corrections.

Finishes and closes work reliably.



General web-development experience without substantial hands-on Shopify development experience will not meet the requirement for this role.



ENGAGEMENT DETAILS

Full-time, long-term Independent Contractor engagement.

Expected workload: 40 hours per week.

Target rate: $7-$10 USD per hour, based on demonstrated Shopify capability and experience.

Must be available for scheduled Pacific Time alignment and agreed working-hour overlap.

Long-term opportunity for the right person.

Department: Marketing.

Reports directly to Joseph Hyun, CEO.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your resume/CV and portfolio. Your application should include:



Links to 2-3 live Shopify stores you personally worked on.

For each store, tell us exactly what you personally built, changed, fixed, or optimized.

Describe one technically difficult Shopify issue you diagnosed. What was the root cause, what did you change, and how did you verify the fix?

Give one concrete example of Shopify work where you personally used Liquid and JavaScript.

Tell us about a time a web-development task was at risk of missing its deadline. What did you do before the deadline was missed?

Confirm your availability for full-time work and Pacific Time alignment.



We hire based on evidence of Shopify capability, judgment, ownership, and execution, not titles alone.

title: CapCut only editor for Instagram Reels - Soft/warm AI educational video
description:
Hi I'm Cindy! I run an AI education brand with a 200k+ audience across two Instagram accounts. My reels teach people how to actually use Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and AI builds. I'm hiring editors to take a finished cut and turn it into the finished video. My style is a cute + scrapbook style and I explain AI concepts and builds.



Role description



You get the cut with the bad takes and pauses already removed. I also provide my editors an Editing Guide which includes where to grab screenshots/ screen recordings, so you're never working on a blank page. You'll also have the support of my Senior Editors, who can guide you to align closely with my style. 



Here's the role:

- Understand the concept being taught or refer to the Editing Guide for more inspiration.

- Source and build the screen recordings. If I'm talking about a tool, the viewer needs to see it in action. You capture or assemble those and align them to the exact words they belong to.

- Sound design. Every visual reveal gets a sound cue: a pop, a click, a page turn, a soft ding. There is no music. My voice plus sound effects carry the whole video.

- Good pacing. 



The short version: I explain the idea out loud, and you build everything the viewer needs to see to understand it.



Hard requirements



- CapCut proficiency. 

- Comfortable capturing and editing screen recordings

- You use AI tools yourself. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be generating images and diagrams with them already.

- Strong eye for short-form pacing on Instagram

- Warm, cute, arts-and-crafts taste. Never corporate, never tech-bro.

- Fluent English, good enough to follow a technical explanation and know what it means

- Turnaround of 1 to 2 days per reel



Nice to have



- You already use Claude or ChatGPT day to day

- Experience editing for AI, tech or educational creators

- Familiar with current Instagram hook formats and retention edits



Hard nos



Hard whip-pans, glitch or VHS effects, trending transition packs, generic tech stock footage, corporate imagery, harsh blues and neon.



The editing support you get



- Editing Guide so you know which assets to grab or record.

- CapCut Pro 

- Reference videos for every video you edit so you have a place to grab inspiration

- The cut of each reel, already trimmed

- Clear, fast feedback so you can lock the style within a few reels

- Support from our Senior Editors



PAY



- USD $35 per reel, paid through Upwork as a milestone per reel.

- Rate increases as you align closer to my style. 

- Steady, consistent volume. We publish constantly and there is always more work.



How to apply



Answer the screening questions, and attach 2 to 3 short-form samples you personally edited (CapCut preferred). Start your first answer with the words "capcut teams" so I know you read the whole post.

title: CapCut only editor for Instagram Reels - Soft/warm AI educational video
description:
Hi I'm Cindy! I run an AI education brand with a 200k+ audience across two Instagram accounts. My reels teach people how to actually use Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and AI builds. I'm hiring editors to take a finished cut and turn it into the finished video. My style is a cute + scrapbook style and I explain AI concepts and builds.



Role description



You get the cut with the bad takes and pauses already removed. I also provide my editors an Editing Guide which includes where to grab screenshots/ screen recordings, so you're never working on a blank page. You'll also have the support of my Senior Editors, who can guide you to align closely with my style. 



Here's the role:

- Understand the concept being taught or refer to the Editing Guide for more inspiration.

- Source and build the screen recordings. If I'm talking about a tool, the viewer needs to see it in action. You capture or assemble those and align them to the exact words they belong to.

- Sound design. Every visual reveal gets a sound cue: a pop, a click, a page turn, a soft ding. There is no music. My voice plus sound effects carry the whole video.

- Good pacing. 



The short version: I explain the idea out loud, and you build everything the viewer needs to see to understand it.



Hard requirements



- CapCut proficiency. 

- Comfortable capturing and editing screen recordings

- You use AI tools yourself. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be generating images and diagrams with them already.

- Strong eye for short-form pacing on Instagram

- Warm, cute, arts-and-crafts taste. Never corporate, never tech-bro.

- Fluent English, good enough to follow a technical explanation and know what it means

- Turnaround of 1 to 2 days per reel



Nice to have



- You already use Claude or ChatGPT day to day

- Experience editing for AI, tech or educational creators

- Familiar with current Instagram hook formats and retention edits



Hard nos



Hard whip-pans, glitch or VHS effects, trending transition packs, generic tech stock footage, corporate imagery, harsh blues and neon.



The editing support you get



- Editing Guide so you know which assets to grab or record.

- CapCut Pro 

- Reference videos for every video you edit so you have a place to grab inspiration

- The cut of each reel, already trimmed

- Clear, fast feedback so you can lock the style within a few reels

- Support from our Senior Editors



PAY



- USD $35 per reel, paid through Upwork as a milestone per reel.

- Rate increases as you align closer to my style. 

- Steady, consistent volume. We publish constantly and there is always more work.



How to apply



Answer the screening questions, and attach 2 to 3 short-form samples you personally edited (CapCut preferred). Start your first answer with the words "capcut teams" so I know you read the whole post.

About Let Sparks Fly®



Let Sparks Fly® is an award-winning group travel company specializing in elevated, unforgettable travel experiences for Black women. Recognized on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list (#108), we've spent the past six years building a trusted travel community rooted in luxury, sisterhood, cultural exploration, and meaningful connection.



More than a travel company, we create experiences that bring women together, inspire confidence, and foster lifelong friendships. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a creative content specialist who can help us tell our story and expand our reach through engaging, high-quality content.



Position Overview



We're looking for a creative, organized, and trend-savvy Social Media & Video Content Specialist to manage content for both the Let Sparks Fly® brand and the Founder & CEO's personal brand.



This role is responsible for creating, editing, and publishing engaging content across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube. You'll transform existing photos and videos into compelling content while also developing original graphics and creative assets that strengthen our brand and increase engagement.



Key Responsibilities

1. Manage the day-to-day content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

2. Create and edit both short-form and long-form videos, including Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube Shorts, YouTube videos, and LinkedIn videos.

4. Create graphics, carousel posts, thumbnails, story graphics, cover images, and other branded social media assets.

5. Write engaging captions, video titles, descriptions, and calls to action.

6. Schedule and publish content across all platforms.

7. Maintain and organize a content calendar.

8. Stay current on social media trends and recommend new content ideas.

9. Organize and maintain our library of photos, videos, and creative assets.

10. Monitor content performance and recommend ways to improve engagement and reach.

11. Ensure all content aligns with the Let Sparks Fly® brand and voice.



Required Skills & Experience

1. Proven experience creating content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

2. Strong video editing skills with experience creating engaging short-form and long-form content.

3. Experience creating high-quality graphics and branded social media assets.

4. Strong understanding of storytelling, content strategy, and current social media trends.

5. Excellent attention to detail and organization.

Your resume.

title: Outbound Telesales Representative
description:
B2B Tech Appointment Setter - Part-Time (2 Hours/Day) - UK Market



Position: Outbound B2B Appointment Setter (Freelance/Contract)



Industry: Artificial Intelligence and Software Development



Hours: 10 Hours/Week (Monday to Friday, 09:30 AM - 11:30 AM UK Time)

Compensation: Competitive Hourly Base Rate + High-Upside Commission on Closed Deals



About the Opportunity

Artificial Intelligence is changing the world, and companies across the United Kingdom are actively seeking ways to leverage it. At our AI Software Development Agency, we design custom, cutting-edge AI solutions and agentic workflows that solve complex operational problems for mid-sized enterprises.



We are expanding our outbound outreach and looking for an elite, articulate, and persuasive B2B Tech Appointment Setter. This is a highly focused, premium prospecting role requiring just 2 hours per day during peak morning dialing hours in the UK. 



If you are a high-performing sales professional looking for a flexible, high-leverage micro-shift in the tech space, this is for you.

Your sole mission? Open doors, bypass gatekeepers, spark curiosity about AI capabilities, and secure high-quality phone appointments for our senior technical consultants.



Key Responsibilities

1. Targeted Outbound Prospecting: Execute high-volume, premium cold calls to C-level executives, CTOs, CIOs, and Operations Directors at medium-sized UK enterprises.

2. Intelligent Qualification: Move past basic scripts to uncover structural business friction points that our custom AI agents can solve.

3.Appointment Setting: Successfully secure and schedule dedicated phone consultations between qualified UK prospects and our core consultancy team.

4. Pipeline Tracking: Keep structured, clean notes on call outcomes, decision-maker contact details, and follow-up timelines.



What We Are Looking For

To excel in this role, you must bring a consultative, high-intelligence approach to tech sales. We are seeking candidates who possess:

1. Stellar English and Communication: Flawless verbal English with a polished, engaging, and authoritative phone manner capable of holding peer-level conversations with corporate executives.

2. Proven B2B Sales Track Record: Verifiable outbound cold-calling experience. You must be able to demonstrate a history of hitting dial targets and overcoming tough objections.

3. Technical Sales Fluency: Previous experience in software, SaaS, cloud, or technical IT sales is highly preferred. You should feel comfortable using terms like automation workflows, software integrations, and ROI efficiency.

4. UK Market Familiarity: An understanding of UK business culture, etiquette, and time zones is a massive advantage.



What Is in it for You?

1. High-Leverage Hours: Earn a competitive hourly baseline while working only 2 hours a day-perfect for balancing with other projects or lifestyle commitments.

2. Aggressive Commission Structure: We do not just reward you for setting the meeting. In addition to your base pay, you will receive a significant cash bonus for every meeting you book that converts into an agency contract. Selling high-ticket custom AI services means your commission potential is immense. 

3. Cutting-Edge Industry: Gain direct exposure to the booming generative AI and agentic software industry alongside an expert development team.



How to Apply (Mandatory Requirements)

We prioritize performance and professionalism above all else. To be considered for an interview, your application must include the following three details:

1. A Verifiable Reference: Provide a contact name, company name, or reference letter explicitly stating your sales track record (e.g., how many cold calls you executed, or how many qualified B2B meetings/deals you closed in a previous sales campaign).

2. Daily Call Capacity: Based on a focused 2-hour morning window, state realistically how many high-quality, outbound corporate dials you can execute.

3. Your Cold Calling Approach: Give us a brief 2-3 sentence summary of your experience with cold calling into technical or corporate environments, highlighting how you handle gatekeepers or initial rejection.

title: Full-Time Meta Media Buyer for E-Commerce | Retainer + Performance Bonus
description:
We do not need a media buyer who hides behind complicated campaign structures.



We need someone who can look at the numbers, understand exactly what is happening, and make the correct decision quickly.



We operate a growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands across multiple niches. We are looking for an experienced Meta Media Buyer to take full-time responsibility for the performance and scaling of our advertising accounts.



This is a long-term position for an individual, not an agency. It should be your primary full-time role rather than one of many small client accounts.



HOW OUR SYSTEM WORKS



We use a straightforward campaign structure:



* ABO campaigns for testing

* CBO campaigns for scaling

* Automated creative launches

* Clear KPI targets and decision-making rules

* Approximately 100 new creatives tested across our brands each week



Our infrastructure and launch systems are already built.



Your value will come from reading the data, monitoring the accounts, identifying problems, making fast decisions, and scaling spend while maintaining the required KPIs.



We are not looking for someone who constantly introduces unnecessary campaign structures. We want someone who understands that excellent media buying comes down to disciplined execution, accurate data interpretation, and consistent account management.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will:



* Monitor all Meta advertising accounts daily

* Oversee multiple brands across different e-commerce niches

* Make sure automated launches run correctly

* Identify delivery, tracking, spending, or campaign issues quickly

* Evaluate new creatives inside our ABO testing structure

* Move proven winners into CBO scaling campaigns

* Increase or decrease budgets according to defined KPI targets

* Scale winning campaigns while protecting overall profitability

* Stop losing campaigns before they waste unnecessary budget

* Maintain a clear overview of performance across all brands

* Track daily and weekly results

* Communicate important changes, problems, and opportunities clearly

* Provide feedback about which creatives, angles, and audiences are performing

* Handle a high volume of approximately 100 new creatives per week

* Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy



The role is heavily focused on monitoring, analysis, decision-making, and execution. You will not need to spend your day manually building every campaign because our launch process is already automated.



WHAT YOU MUST UNDERSTAND



You must be comfortable working with metrics such as:



* CPA

* ROAS

* Break-even ROAS

* MER

* CPM

* CTR

* CPC

* Conversion rate

* Average order value

* Daily spend

* Budget allocation

* Creative-level performance

* Account-level profitability



You should understand the difference between short-term fluctuations and meaningful performance changes.



You must also know when to give a campaign more time, when to reduce spend, when to stop it, and when to scale aggressively.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should:



* Have proven experience managing Meta/Facebook advertising for e-commerce brands

* Have strong experience with both ABO testing and CBO scaling

* Be extremely comfortable with numbers

* Make decisions based on KPIs rather than emotions or guesses

* Be able to work across several advertising accounts without losing oversight

* Be a fast and disciplined executor

* Enjoy spending time inside Ads Manager, dashboards, and spreadsheets

* Be highly focused, ambitious, and results-driven

* Take ownership instead of waiting to be told about every small problem

* Be able to identify issues before they become expensive

* Be comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

* Be available for consistent daily account monitoring

* Be comfortable performing light weekend checks when necessary

* Communicate clearly and reliably

* Have experience using AI to improve analysis, reporting, and workflow efficiency



AI experience is valuable, but you must still be capable of interpreting the numbers and making decisions independently.



This role is best suited to someone who genuinely enjoys working. You should enjoy seeing campaigns improve, creatives begin spending, and brands scale as a result of your decisions.



If you prefer slow environments, limited responsibility, or managing many unrelated clients at once, this will probably not be the right position.



COMPENSATION



The compensation structure includes:



* A fixed ongoing retainer

* A tiered performance bonus based on advertising spend achieved while maintaining the agreed KPIs

* Increased compensation as responsibility and results grow



The better our brands scale within the required performance targets, the more you can earn.



You will have the opportunity to work with a variety of products and markets, see new creatives tested at a high volume, and play an important role in rapidly scaling multiple e-commerce brands.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



You will not be joining a slow corporate team or working on one account with a small number of monthly tests.



You will be part of a dynamic e-commerce team that:



* Launches and tests approximately 100 new creatives per week

* Operates multiple brands across different niches

* Makes decisions quickly

* Rewards measurable results

* Uses automation to remove unnecessary manual work

* Gives strong performers significant responsibility

* Provides the opportunity to scale alongside the company



We are looking for someone who wants to become a key long-term part of the team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your proposal with the words “NUMBERS FIRST” so we know you read the complete job post.



Please also answer the following questions:



1. How many years of Meta media-buying experience do you have?



2. What types of e-commerce brands have you worked with?



3. What level of monthly advertising spend have you personally managed?



4. Explain how you normally use ABO campaigns for testing and CBO campaigns for scaling.



5. Tell us about a campaign you successfully scaled while maintaining its required KPIs.



6. Which numbers do you check first when evaluating a newly launched creative?



7. How do you determine whether a weak result is temporary volatility or a real performance problem?



8. How have you used AI to improve your media-buying workflow?



9. Are you available for a full-time, long-term position?



10. What fixed monthly retainer would you expect?



We are looking for someone who loves numbers, moves quickly, takes ownership, and finds genuine satisfaction in seeing advertising accounts and brands scale.

title: Web Research & Lead Generation Assistant – Entry Level | Excellent English
description:
We are a small Canadian web design company looking for a full-time Website Research & Review Assistant in the Philippines



This is an entry-level position. You do not need advanced technical skills, coding experience, or previous web-design experience. We will train the right person.



What matters most to us is:



excellent written and spoken English

good judgment

attention to detail

reliability

comfort using Google and websites

ability to follow a simple process consistently

What you will do



Your main job is to research Canadian local businesses and identify companies whose current websites are outdated, poorly designed, incomplete, or clearly in need of improvement.



For each qualified business, you will collect basic information such as:



Business name

City

Website

 address

Contact-form URL


Instagram

LinkedIn



You are not expected to write long reports or technical website audits.



We want people who can look at a business website and make a sensible judgment:



Is this a real, active business with a website that could clearly be improved?

The important word is accepted. Sending us 80 poor-quality or unsuitable businesses does not meet the target. Accuracy and judgment matter.

Clear training and examples

A simple repeatable workflow

Full-time remote work

Flexible Philippine daytime working hours

Opportunity to grow with a small Canadian company

Optional additional earning opportunity

However, once your normal assigned work is complete and meeting our quality standard, you may also find your own clients for 3Lions if you enjoy sales or business development.



For new business that you personally originate and close outside our existing prospect pipeline, we offer a 50% share of collected project revenue.



This is optional upside — not a replacement for your regular salary.



Who this role would suit



This could be a very good first serious online job for someone who is smart, dependable and eager to learn.



Previous VA or lead-generation experience is helpful, but not required.



We would rather hire someone with excellent English, good judgment and a strong work ethic than someone with years of experience who does careless work.



You must have:



Your own reliable computer

Stable internet connection

Strong English

Basic familiarity with Google Sheets

Ability to work independently

How to apply



Start your application with the word LION so we know you read the entire posting.

1. Tell us a little about yourself in 4–6 sentences, in your own words.



2. Why does this type of research work interest you?



3. Find 3 Canadian local service businesses whose websites you believe could use a major redesign. For each one, send us:



business name

city

website

one short sentence explaining why you selected it



Please keep your application concise. We are not looking for a long cover letter.



Selected applicants will be invited to complete a short paid practical test using the same type of work they would do in the actual job.



We are looking for someone we can train, trust and work with long term.

title: Website Quality Reviewer / Visual QA Assistant – Full Time
description:
We are a small Canadian web design company looking for a full-time Website Quality Reviewer / Visual QA Assistant in the Philippines.



Your job is to review website redesigns before they are approved for our sales team.



You do not need to be a programmer.



You do need:



excellent English

very strong attention to detail

good visual judgment

comfort using websites on desktop and mobile

the ability to notice when something looks wrong, incomplete, generic or unprofessional

the ability to explain a problem clearly in one or two sentences

What you will do



For each assignment, you will usually receive:



the business’s current website

our redesigned demo website



Your job is to compare them and d
 whether the demo is ready.



You will review things such as:



Does the redesign still clearly belong to the real business?

Are the company’s real logo, colours and identity being respected?

Did important services, information and useful content survive the redesign?

Is the homepage strong?

Are the important inner pages also strong?

Does the website look professional on desktop and mobile?

Are there strange spacing problems, weak image choices or awkward layouts?

Do navigation, buttons and links work?

Does the estimate / quote experience work properly?

Are there suspicious, unsupported or obviously incorrect business claims?

Does anything look generic, unfinished or obviously AI-generated?

Your output should be simple



Most reviews should end with one of two results:



PASS



or



FIX — followed by the specific issue that needs correction



Example:



FIX — The Exterior Painting page is much weaker than the homepage and uses the same repeated layout as the Interior page.



We do not want long reports.



We want good judgment and useful observations.



Daily target



Once fully trained, the normal target will be approximately 80 accepted website audits per working day.



The important word is accepted.



Speed matters, but accuracy matters more.



If obvious problems are missed, the audit does not count simply because it was completed quickly.



Why this role matters



Your reviews help improve both the individual website and the way we build future websites.



If you notice the same problem repeatedly across several websites, we want you to flag that pattern.



For example:



service pages repeatedly feel too generic

mobile headers repeatedly have spacing problems

important source content keeps disappearing

quote buttons are hard to find

image crops repeatedly look poor



Repeated findings help us improve our production process.



What we provide

Clear training and examples

A repeatable review process

Full-time remote work

Flexible Philippine daytime working hours

Opportunity to grow with a small Canadian company

Optional additional earning opportunity



Sales are not required for this position.



Once your assigned daily work is complete and meeting our quality standard, you may also source your own clients for 3Lions if you enjoy sales or business development.



For new business that you personally originate and close outside our existing prospect pipeline, we offer a 50% share of collected project revenue.



This is optional additional income, not a replacement for your regular salary.



Who this role would suit



This role would suit someone who:



notices visual details other people miss

enjoys looking at websites and design

can quickly distinguish between something that looks professional and something that looks mediocre

is comfortable giving clear, direct feedback

works independently

takes accuracy seriously



Previous web-design, graphic-design, website-testing or QA experience is helpful, but coding ability is not required.



You must have:



Your own reliable computer

Stable internet connection

Strong English

Basic familiarity with Google Sheets

Ability to review websites on both desktop and mobile

How to apply
