title: Recruiter / Hiring Assistant
description:
Recruiter / Hiring Assistant

Company: 850 Club Credit

Position: Recruiter / Hiring Assistant

Type: Part-Time

Pay: $7.50/hour

Hours: Up to 10 hours per week / 40 hours per month

Bonus: $50 for each successful hire who remains with the company for at least 30 days



How to Apply

Please submit:



1. Reply to job posting with the Subject Line: IM YOUR RECRUITER

2. Your resume

3. A short description of your recruiting experience

4. The types of positions you have recruited for

5. How many candidates you typically screen before recommending someone for an interview

6. A short video via google drive or loom video link recording introducing yourself

7. Your current availability



Applications that do not follow instructions, will not be considered.



About the Role

850 Club Credit is looking for an organized, proactive Recruiter / Hiring Assistant who can help us find, screen, and organize strong candidates for our growing team.



Your job is not simply to post job listings.



Your job is to help us hire faster by filtering out weak applicants and making sure only qualified candidates reach the final interview stage.



You will handle the recruiting process from job posting through candidate screening, initial interviews, trial tasks, interview scheduling, and candidate follow-up. The CEO of 850 Club Credit, Calvin, will make all final hiring decisions



Your Responsibilities



You will:



* Post job openings on approved hiring platforms

* Review and organize incoming applications

* Remove applicants who clearly do not meet the requirements

* Screen candidates for English communication, experience, availability, pay expectations, and internet reliability

* Conduct initial candidate interviews

* Record candidate interviews using approved 850 Club Credit Zoom or Google Meet accounts

* Coordinate trial/test assignments

* Collect completed trial assignments

* Create candidate shortlists

* Score candidates using our hiring scorecard

* Present the strongest candidates to Calvin

* Schedule approved candidates on Calvin's interview calendar

* Confirm interviews with candidates

* Follow up before interviews to reduce no-shows

* Communicate hiring decisions and approved offers to selected candidates

* Track whether new hires successfully complete their trial period

* Provide recruiting updates every 2–3 days during active hiring



**IMPORTANT:** All recruiting communication must use approved 850 Club Credit
 addresses, Zoom links, Google Meet links, and company systems.



Candidate Information You Must Collect

Before recommending a candidate, you should provide:



* Full name

* Location and time zone

* Position applied for

* Pay expectations

* Schedule availability

* Relevant experience summary

* Resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile

* Internet speed screenshot

* Voice recording for sales applicants

* Recording of your initial interview with the candidate

* Trial/test task results when applicable

* Recruiter score from 1–5

* Final recommendation: **Interview / Maybe / Reject**



Calvin should be able to look at your candidate report and quickly understand whether someone deserves a final interview.



Initial Hiring Sprint

Our immediate goal is to complete the first recruiting sprint within approximately 10–14 days.



Expected timeline:



**Days 1–3:** Approved job postings are live.



**Days 4–5:** First group of qualified candidates is presented.



**By Day 7:** We expect approximately 5–10 qualified applicants for priority roles.



**By Day 10:** Additional qualified candidates and initial interviews should be completed.



**By Day 14:** Strong finalists should be ready for final interviews and hiring decisions.



We expect recruiting updates approximately every **2–3 days** while positions are actively being filled.



What Success Looks Like



For each assigned position, we expect you to generate a strong pool of qualified applicants rather than simply sending us everyone who applies.



For example, an active hiring campaign may require:



**Sales Enrollment Specialist:** 10–15 qualified applicants



**Customer Service / Operations:** 5–8 qualified applicants



Quality is more important than simply hitting an application number.



We want you to protect Calvin's time by eliminating poor candidates before they reach his calendar.



What You Will NOT Be Responsible For

You will **not**:



* Make the final hiring decision

* Negotiate compensation beyond approved ranges

* Create company strategy

* Determine company staffing strategy

* Train employees long-term

* Manage employees after they are hired

* Change job requirements or compensation without approval



Your responsibility ends primarily with helping us identify, screen, organize, and successfully hire great candidates.



Compensation



**$7.50/hour**



Maximum of approximately **10 hours per week / 40 hours per month** unless additional hours are approved in advance.



There is also a:



**$50 Successful Hire Bonus**



The bonus is earned for each approved candidate you recruit who is hired and remains successfully employed with 850 Club Credit for at least **30 days**.



All working time must be properly tracked using the company's approved time-tracking system.



Additional hours must be approved before they are worked.



Who We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if you:



* Have previous recruiting or hiring experience

* Have experience using OnlineJobs.ph

* Are comfortable interviewing candidates

* Have strong written and spoken English

* Can identify strong candidates quickly

* Are extremely organized

* Follow instructions carefully

* Communicate consistently

* Are comfortable rejecting applicants who don't meet requirements

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Understand that quality matters more than the number of applications received



Experience recruiting salespeople, customer service representatives, virtual assistants, or operations staff is a major plus.



How to Apply

Please submit:



1. Reply to job posting with the Subject Line: IM YOUR RECRUITER

2. Your resume

3. A short description of your recruiting experience

4. The types of positions you have recruited for

5. How many candidates you typically screen before recommending someone for an interview

6. A short video via google drive or loom video link recording introducing yourself

7. Your current availability



Applications that do not follow instructions, will not be considered.

title: Executive Assistant / Creative Operations Assistant – Part-Time
description:
Executive Assistant / Creative Operations Assistant – Part-Time, Growth Opportunity



We are a small but growing U.S.-based creative brand looking for a smart, highly organized, and proactive Executive Assistant / Creative Operations Assistant to join our team.



This role will work directly with the Founder and requires a high level of organization, discretion, accountability, and follow-through. You will help the Founder stay organized, keep priorities moving, and ensure that important administrative, financial, client, and creative tasks do not fall through the cracks.



This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role. We are looking for someone multi-talented, resourceful, and comfortable wearing different hats in a growing business. One day you may be following up on an invoice or organizing QuickBooks records, and the next you may be scheduling social media content, updating a Canva graphic, or helping coordinate a client project.



The position will begin part-time, with the opportunity to gradually transition into a full-time role as the business grows and responsibilities increase.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



- Working directly with the Founder to manage priorities, schedules, reminders, and follow-ups

- Helping maintain strong organization across the business and proactively identifying items requiring attention

- Providing administrative and executive support

- Assisting with client communication and tracking outstanding items

- Using QuickBooks Online for basic bookkeeping, invoice management, expense categorization, and payment tracking

- Organizing business documents, receipts, invoices, and records

- Helping manage and schedule content across Instagram, TikTok,
, YouTube, and other platforms

- Writing and proofreading captions and basic marketing content

- Using Canva, CapCut, or similar tools for basic content editing

- Organizing photos, videos, and other digital assets

- Assisting with research and other operational tasks

- Following through on assigned tasks without requiring constant reminders



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a great fit if you are:



- Exceptionally organized and able to keep track of multiple priorities at once

- Able to anticipate needs rather than waiting to be told what to do

- Proficient in QuickBooks Online

- Comfortable managing social media content

- Familiar with Canva, CapCut, or similar basic editing tools

- Tech-savvy and able to learn new systems quickly

- Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking initiative

- Dependable with strong attention to detail

- Professional, personable, and relatable

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

- Experienced working with U.S. or other international brands or clients



English Requirement



Mastery-level written and spoken English is required.



You will communicate directly with the Founder, team members, and occasionally clients. You should be able to communicate naturally, professionally, and confidently in English without relying heavily on AI for routine business communication.



Hours & Growth



This role will initially be part-time. We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term relationship with the company rather than simply taking on another short-term freelance project.



As the company grows and you demonstrate your capabilities, the position is expected to expand in hours, responsibilities, and compensation, with the potential to become full-time.



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and why you believe you would be a good fit for this role.

2. Your experience supporting a founder, executive, or small-business owner.

3. Your experience using QuickBooks Online.

4. Your experience managing social media for a business or brand.

5. The editing/design tools you are comfortable using.

6. Your experience working with U.S. or international clients/brands.

7. Your current availability and preferred working hours.

8. Your expected hourly rate.

9. Links or examples of social media accounts, graphics, videos, or other relevant work you have helped manage.



Important: At the beginning of your application, include the words “Creative EA” so we know you read the entire job description.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, take ownership of their work, and become a trusted part of the business.

Full Time | Long Term | Australian E-commerce Brand



Peak Chocolate is a fast-growing Australian functional chocolate brand.



We’re looking for someone to join our team long term and take ownership of creator and influencer outreach across Instagram and TikTok.



This is not a generic social media VA role.



We want someone who has already worked hands-on with e-commerce or consumer brands and knows how to find the right creators, start conversations, manage replies, follow up, organise product seeding and build genuine creator relationships.



What you’ll own



You’ll help run and improve our creator outreach system across Australia and New Zealand.



Your work will include:



• Finding high-quality creators who genuinely fit the Peak brand

• Instagram and TikTok DM outreach

• Managing creator replies and ongoing conversations

• Product gifting and seeding campaigns

• Following up with creators after products arrive

• Building long-term relationships with strong creators

• Tracking outreach, product sends, content and results

• Identifying what is working and recommending what we should do more of

• Helping us continuously improve scripts, targeting and processes



We already have existing systems, scripts and outreach experience. We’re looking for someone who can improve them, not simply follow them blindly.



You could be a great fit if



• You have real influencer or creator outreach experience

• You have worked with e-commerce, DTC or consumer brands

• You have personally done Instagram and/or TikTok outreach

• You understand influencer gifting, UGC or product seeding

• You are extremely organised with follow-ups

• Your written English is excellent

• You are comfortable making decisions and suggesting improvements

• You care about outcomes, not just the number of messages sent



Experience with food, beverage, wellness, supplements, beauty or Amazon is a big plus.



This role is probably NOT for you if



• Your experience is mainly Canva and posting social media content

• Your outreach experience is mainly B2B cold
 or appointment setting

• You only build influencer lists but don’t manage conversations

• You need detailed instructions for every task

• You are looking to juggle many clients rather than join one brand long term



The role



We are looking for someone who ultimately wants a full-time, long-term position with Peak Chocolate.



You’ll work closely with the founders and become an important part of the brand as we grow.



There is plenty of room for the role to grow for the right person.



How to apply



Please start your application with the words:



PEAK CREATOR



Then answer these 4 questions:



Tell us about one e-commerce or consumer brand where you personally managed influencer or creator outreach.

Give us one example of something you changed or improved in an outreach campaign without the client telling you exactly what to do.

If you joined Peak and were asked to send product to Australian creators to generate awareness and sales, what would you want to understand before you started?



Please do not send a generic cover letter. Short, specific answers are much more valuable to us.

title: TIER A CREATIVE DESIGNER
description:
READ



TIER A CREATIVE DESIGNER



IF YOU’RE JUST A “NORMAL” DESIGNER, DO NOT APPLY.



We are not looking for someone who can simply “do graphic design.”



We’re looking for a Tier A multidisciplinary creative — someone with exceptional visual taste, original ideas and the technical ability to bring those ideas to life across design, AI, packaging, video, digital and brand.



You should be able to take a rough idea and turn it into something significantly better than what was originally briefed.



If you need every reference, layout, concept and direction given to you before you can start, this role is not for you.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Develop original creative concepts and campaign directions for SUPR

- Create high-level graphics for social media, advertising, website and e-commerce

- Design product packaging, labels, pouches, boxes, retail displays and other physical brand assets

- Understand print-ready artwork, dimensions, bleed, dielines and production requirements

- Create product mockups and launch visuals

- Use AI creative tools to accelerate and elevate concepts, visuals and production

- Generate and manipulate AI imagery while maintaining brand consistency

- Edit short-form videos, Reels, TikToks and advertisements

- Create engaging cuts, transitions, typography, subtitles, sound design and basic motion graphics

- Turn raw footage into polished, brand-ready content

- Create performance ad creatives for Meta, TikTok and other platforms

- Develop website banners, product pages, marketplace creatives and campaign assets

- Build strong typography, layouts and visual systems

- Adapt campaigns across multiple formats without simply resizing the same artwork

- Work across static, motion, video, AI and physical packaging

- Proactively bring new ideas and creative directions to the team

- Do more than what is given — identify what can be improved and make it better



YOU SHOULD BE STRONG IN



Graphic Design

Photoshop, Illustrator and other professional creative tools.



AI Creative

Comfortable using modern AI image/video tools as part of a professional creative workflow. We want someone who knows how to use AI creatively — not someone who depends on it to compensate for weak design fundamentals.



Packaging Design

Able to work from concept through to production-ready packaging artwork.



Video Editing

Able to turn raw footage into strong Reels, TikToks, product videos, campaign edits and paid advertisements.



Branding & Art Direction

Strong understanding of typography, composition, visual hierarchy, colour, photography and brand consistency.



Digital & E-Commerce

Understand that creative for Meta, TikTok, Shopify and marketplaces needs to do more than simply look good — it needs to communicate and convert.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR EVERYONE



Do not apply if:



- Your portfolio mainly consists of basic Canva graphics

- You rely heavily on templates

- You only know static graphic design

- You cannot edit videos

- You have no understanding of packaging or production artwork

- You use AI without strong underlying design skills

- You simply copy references

- You need detailed instructions for every creative decision

- You only complete exactly what is assigned

- You cannot conceptualise independently

- You are looking for a position to learn the basics



WE ARE STRICTLY LOOKING FOR TIER A TALENT.



Your qualifications matter less than what you can actually create.



We want someone who can think, design, edit, experiment, execute and elevate.



TO APPLY



Send us:



1. Your portfolio

2. CV / relevant experience

3. Expected salary

4. Availability / notice period

5. Your 3 strongest creative projects

6. Examples of video editing

7. Examples of packaging / product design

8. Examples of AI-assisted creative work, if available



No strong portfolio = application will not be considered.



We are not hiring someone to simply fill a creative position.



We are looking for someone who can help define what SUPR looks like.

title: Litigation Paralegal
description:
Texas-based plaintiff-side personal injury firm seeking an experienced Litigation Paralegal. This is a fully remote position for a candidate who can independently manage a case from the moment a lawsuit is filed through trial preparation, with no training period required.



What We're Looking For



We are hiring specifically for post-filing litigation work — from petition through trial. This is not a pre-suit or intake-focused role, and we are not seeking anyone who needs to be trained on the fundamentals of personal injury litigation.



Minimum Qualifications



At least 3 years of demonstrated plaintiff-side personal injury litigation experience

Working knowledge of litigation from petition through trial

Working knowledge of Texas civil procedure and Texas law as it applies to personal injury litigation

Direct, hands-on experience with case management software

Experience managing a high-volume active caseload of filed litigation matters



Duties and Responsibilities



Draft original petitions and initiate new lawsuits

Draft and file amended petitions

Draft discovery requests, including interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission

Draft responses to discovery requests received from opposing counsel

Complete Defendant's Written Discovery Questionnaires (DWQs)

Identify appropriate expert witnesses for each case

Prepare and file designation of experts

Prepare initial disclosures

Prepare for and coordinate depositions, including scheduling, exhibit preparation, and logistics with opposing counsel, court reporters, and clients

Track and manage all case deadlines

Communicate directly with clients, opposing counsel, and insurance adjusters as needed



Schedule



This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be resourceful and capable of ensuring physical tasks get done even while working remotely — for example, coordinating with in-office staff to have documents printed, organized, or delivered, or arranging third-party legal support services to handle physical trial preparation, exhibit production, or courier needs. The ability to problem-solve and make these things happen without being physically present is essential. Candidates must be available and reachable approximately 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday. Some scheduling flexibility is available for the right candidate.



International applicants: this schedule is fixed to Central Time (United States), not your local time zone. If you are located in the Philippines, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time falls at approximately 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine time, meaning this would be an overnight shift for you. Please confirm you understand this before applying and that you are able and willing to work these hours on your local clock.



Compensation



Salary is commensurate with experience. Please include your minimum compensation requirement with your application.



To Apply



Please include the following with your application:



Number of years of plaintiff-side litigation experience?



Confirmation that you can independently handle litigation work from petition through trial preparation.



Your typical caseload volume and whether managed solo or as part of a team?



Your minimum hourly rate or salary requirement?



Confirmation that you are able to begin work without a training period?



A description of a time you had to ensure a physical task (printing, filing, document delivery, etc.) got completed without being on-site, and how you made it happen?



Confirmation that you are able to work 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday. If you are applying from outside the United States, please confirm you understand what this means in your local time zone and that you are able and willing to work those hours.

description:
# Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $2,200/Month



## READ FIRST — BOTH PAID TEST VIDEOS REQUIRED



You must complete **BOTH paid test videos** to be considered for this position.



Both tests are paid whether or not you are hired.



**Google Drive Test Folder:**

**Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor**



**Starting pay: $2,200 USD/month**



There are several opportunities to move into **higher-paying and higher-responsibility positions** based on performance.



This is a long-term, high-output position.



---



## SCHEDULE



* **6–7 days per week**

* Approximately **10 hours per normal working day**

* Must regularly be available to work until approximately **3:00 AM PH time or later**

* Some high-volume days may require **14–16 hours**

If you want a strict 40-hour workweek, Monday–Friday schedule, or daytime-only PH hours, this is not the right position.

* Talking-head videos

* Voiceover and b-roll videos

* TikTok Shop content

* Product videos

* Commentary and trend-based content



Responsibilities include:



* Cutting dead space and maintaining fast pacing

* Selecting the strongest takes

* Adding overlays, images, screenshots, comments, and b-roll

* Independently sourcing visual assets

* Matching visuals to scripts and voiceovers

* Using crops, zooms, reframes, and other edits to keep videos engaging

* Reviewing your own work before submission

* Following current TikTok trends

* Learning the brands, creators, products, and pages we work with



---



## REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* **Excellent English comprehension**

* **Excellent communication**

* **Excellent high-speed internet**

* **Excellent understanding of American culture**

* Strong understanding of American slang, humor, sarcasm, references, and social media

* Strong knowledge of current TikTok trends and internet culture

* Strong familiarity with American celebrities, influencers, brands, memes, and viral topics

* Proven short-form video editing experience

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to edit quickly without sacrificing quality

* Ability to independently source images, screenshots, b-roll, comments, posts, and other assets

* Reliable computer capable of handling high-volume editing

* Ability to work independently without constant instructions

* Ability to take feedback and apply it immediately

* Ability to receive payment through Wise

* Long-term availability



You should naturally understand American internet culture. I should not have to constantly explain jokes, references, celebrities, trends, slang, or why a certain visual belongs in a video.



---



## COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS



Communication is extremely important.



* During working hours: respond within approximately **30 minutes**

* Outside working hours while awake: respond within approximately **1 hour**

* Once you wake up: check and respond to outstanding messages promptly

* If something prevents you from working or responding normally, communicate immediately



This role is not a good fit for someone who regularly disappears for hours without communication.



---



## WHO WILL DO WELL



You will likely do well if you are:



* Very fast

* Extremely detail-oriented

* Highly responsive

* Self-sufficient

* Organized

* Reliable

* Comfortable with direct feedback

* Naturally familiar with TikTok

* Very familiar with American culture and internet trends

* Interested in growing into a larger role



---



## PAY AND GROWTH



Starting pay is **$2,200 USD/month**.



This is not the ceiling.



Strong performers can move into **higher-paying positions** based on:



* Editing quality

* Output

* Reliability

* Communication

* Trend knowledge

Your nursing background will help you understand the needs of seniors, families, and caregivers, while your primary responsibilities will focus on **customer service, sales support, scheduling, recruitment coordination, and administrative operations.**

- Handle pre-screened prospective client calls transferred from our Care Coordination team and help families understand their next steps.

- Schedule consultations directly into our calendar when families are ready to move forward.

rsonal Care, Google Workspace, Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Excel, and other business software.**

- Assist with billing, payroll, and other administrative functions when needed.

## What We’re Looking For



- **Previous professional experience working as a Registered Nurse is required.**

- An active RN license is **not required** for this position.

- Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

- Excellent customer service skills with the ability to communicate with seniors and their families with empathy, patience, and clarity.

- Comfortable speaking with prospective clients and helping guide them toward the appropriate next step.

description:
We are a China-based product sourcing and fulfillment company helping ecommerce sellers with their China supply chain needs.

We’re looking for a business development and partnerships specialist to help us connect with Shopify store owners and sellers on other ecommerce platforms, primarily in the US and Europe.

Our goal is to bring more qualified sellers into paid trials and long-term cooperation with our sourcing and fulfillment team.

We are especially interested in candidates who have worked directly with ecommerce sellers and already have professional relationships that could lead to warm introductions.

WHO WE WANT TO CONNECT WITH

You will develop opportunities through two channels:

1. Direct seller outreach — our main priority

Find and connect with Shopify store owners, independent ecommerce brands, and sellers on other platforms who need China-based sourcing or fulfillment support.

Suitable prospects may be looking for:

- A reliable Chinese supplier or sourcing agent.

- An alternative or backup to their existing supplier.

- Support with product sourcing, supplier coordination, or quality control.

- Dropshipping fulfillment or bulk purchasing.

- Solutions to existing sourcing and fulfillment problems.

Prioritize sellers with active sales or a clear purchasing plan, products our team can support, and a genuine need for our services.

2. Referrals and channel partnerships

Build relationships with dropshipping educators, Shopify coaches, course creators, ecommerce agencies, consultants, and community owners whose students or clients may need our services.

The purpose of these partnerships is to generate relevant seller introductions and customer opportunities.

EXPERIENCE AND RELATIONSHIPS WE VALUE

Have you worked with Shopify sellers as a store operator, customer service representative, virtual assistant, account manager, or sourcing coordinator? That experience could be highly relevant to this role.

We particularly value candidates who:

- Have supported Shopify or other ecommerce sellers with store operations, customer service, order processing, product sourcing, or supplier coordination.

- Have communicated directly with store owners or business decision-makers.

- Understand common seller problems involving suppliers, orders, shipping, and customer satisfaction.

- Maintain professional relationships with sellers who may need China-based sourcing and fulfillment.

- Know dropshipping educators, Shopify coaches, agencies, or community owners who could introduce suitable sellers.

- Can arrange warm introductions with the other person’s permission.

You do not need a large network. A few relevant, trusted relationships can be valuable. Candidates without existing connections are also welcome if they can demonstrate strong customer development skills.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Research and qualify potential ecommerce customers and referral partners.

- Identify and contact relevant owners and decision-makers.

- Where appropriate, approach your existing professional network to explore potential introductions.

- Send personalized outreach through appropriate channels, including
, LinkedIn, and relevant online communities.

- Handle initial replies and follow up consistently.

- Understand prospects’ products, sourcing arrangements, order volume, target markets, and supply chain needs.

- Arrange qualified conversations and coordinate quotation requests with our China team.

- Help interested sellers move toward trial orders and ongoing cooperation.

- Develop referral relationships with educators, agencies, and community owners.

- Maintain accurate records of contacts, conversations, opportunities, and next steps in a shared spreadsheet or CRM.

- Report which approaches generate qualified conversations and customers.

Our China team will confirm product feasibility, approve pricing and service commitments, and handle sourcing and fulfillment operations.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong written English and the ability to communicate clearly in English during business conversations.

- Relevant experience in ecommerce support, B2B outreach, lead generation, appointment setting, sales, or partnership development.

- Familiarity with Shopify, ecommerce operations, dropshipping, or China supply chains.

- Ability to identify customer needs and qualify opportunities—not simply collect contact lists.

- Strong organization, consistent follow-up, and accurate recordkeeping.

- Ability to work independently and learn our services.

- Good judgment when communicating with potential customers.

Please do not promise prices, delivery times, guarantees, or services that our team has not approved.

HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

We evaluate:

- Relevant, qualified seller conversations.

- Warm introductions to suitable sellers and referral partners.

- Qualified quotation requests and trial-order opportunities.

- New paying customers and repeat cooperation.

- Accurate records and consistent follow-up.

Contact-list size and message volume alone are not measures of success. We will review results alongside our team’s pricing, response times, and delivery performance.

SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION

- Part-time: approximately 20 hours per week.

- Agreed overlap with our China team during business hours, with flexibility for conversations in the target market.

- Base pay: USD $500–$800 per month, depending on experience.

- Additional performance bonuses and successful customer referral commissions under a written agreement.

- Referral qualification, attribution, and payment terms will be agreed before outreach begins.

- Shortlisted candidates may complete a paid practical assessment.

- Initial paid 30-day engagement, with the opportunity for long-term cooperation.

HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with SELLER PARTNER and answer these questions:

1. Relevant experience: Have you provided services to Shopify or other ecommerce sellers? Describe your responsibilities and whether you communicated directly with owners or decision-makers.

2. Customer development: Describe one relevant outreach, sales, or referral project. What did you personally do, and what results did you achieve? Anonymized examples are welcome. If you have not done this before, please say so.

3. Existing relationships: Do you currently know sellers, educators, coaches, or agency owners who might be open to an introduction? Describe the relationship, how recently you were in contact, and why our services could be relevant. Do not provide names or private contact details at this stage.

4. Outreach sample: Write a four-sentence message to a Shopify seller who already has a supplier. Use only the company information in this post; do not assume specific prices, delivery times, or guarantees.

5. Availability and expectations: State your weekly availability, expected compensation, and whether your strengths are direct seller outreach, warm introductions, channel partnerships, or a combination.

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph. No live outreach or introductions are required during the application process.

We respect your professional relationships. Do not share confidential customer lists, private account information, or materials belonging to previous employers or clients.

title: Remote Laundromat Admin
description:

## 💵 REVENUE GROWTH & CUSTOMER RETENTION

s sent.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Node, PostgreSQL, AWS) - Long-Term, US Healthtech
description:
We are a US-based health insurance technology company. Our platform handles

Medicare and ACA enrollment, commission accounting, and agent management for

insurance agencies. Real money, real member data, real compliance obTHE ROLE



We are hiring our first dedicated engineer. Today the codebase is built and

maintained by the founder with AI assistance, and it has grown faster than one

person can properly review. We need someone who can read a large codebase

critically, tell us what is wrong with it, and fix it.



This is not a ticket-taking role. You will have real ownership over

architecture decisions and your opinion will shape what we build next. Over

time this can grow into leading a small team.





OUR STACK



Backend:    Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL (Amazon RDS)

Frontend:   React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind

Infra:      AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, RDS, S3, SES, Secrets Manager),

            Vercel, GitHub Actions

Auth:       Google Identity Platform, MFA enforced

AI:         AWS Bedrock, Pinecone (retrieval-augmented assistant)

Comms:      Telnyx (SMS and voice)



Scale: roughly 550 API endpoints, 75+ frontend pages, a Postgres schema with

30+ migrations, and a commission engine that reconciles carrier statements

across 17 insurance carriers.





WHAT YOU WILL OWN IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS



- Build out our staging and deployment pipeline so changes are verified

  before they reach production

- Decompose a large monolithic Express file into maintainable route modules,

  without changing behavior

- Raise test coverage from near zero to something we can actually rely on

- Strengthen authorization checks across the API surface

- Close out the technical controls on our SOC 2 and HIPAA roadmap

  (AWS configuration, logging, access review, key management)

- Tell us honestly what we should be working on that we are not





REQUIREMENTS



- 5+ years building and maintaining production web applications

- Strong Node.js and Express. You should be comfortable in a large, messy,

  real-world codebase, not just greenfield projects

- Strong PostgreSQL. You should be able to read a slow query, explain why it

  is slow, and fix it. Tell us the largest schema you have worked with

- Hands-on AWS. You have deployed and operated services yourself, not just

  handed off to someone else

- TypeScript and React

- You write tests. Jest, Vitest, Playwright, or equivalent

- You have done code review on someone else's work and can explain what you

  look for

- Excellent written English. Much of our communication will be written

- Minimum 3 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time (that is roughly

  9pm to midnight Manila time). This is a hard requirement, please do not

  apply if you cannot commit to it





NICE TO HAVE



- Healthcare, insurance, fintech, or any regulated industry experience

- SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar compliance work

- Experience breaking up a monolith incrementally

- Production experience with LLM APIs and retrieval systems

- Open source contributions





PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF



- Your primary experience is WordPress, Shopify, Wix, or Elementor

- You do not have a GitHub profile with real, readable code on it

- You cannot commit to the overlap hours above

- You are looking for short-term or project-based work. We want someone

  long-termligations.

We operate under HIPAA and are working toward SOC 2 Type II.



We are small, we ship constantly, and the product is already in daily

production use.



HOURS



Our team works US hours. The ideal candidate matches that: roughly 9pm to

6am Manila time, covering a full US Central business day.



If you cannot do the full shift but can commit to at least 4 hours of daily

overlap with US Central mornings, apply anyway and tell us what schedule

you can sustain. We would rather find the right engineer and work out the

hours than lose them over a schedule.

title: Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
# Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist

**Local SEO | Website Optimization | Google Business Profile | Lead Generation**



We are a growing home care company with a clear mission:



**Help seniors live longer, healthier, and more independent lives in their own homes.**



We are building for the long term.



Our marketing is measured by real business outcomes — not likes, impressions, vanity metrics, or activity that looks productive without generating results.



We are hiring a **full-time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist** to work directly with our internal team.



This is a **direct-hire position**.



It is not an agency role, not a freelance project, and not a side job.



We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our organization, understand our business deeply, take ownership of results, and improve our marketing systems over time.



## Your Primary Goal



Your main responsibility is straightforward:



**Increase qualified inbound phone calls and inquiries from families looking for home care services.**



Everything else supports that goal.



Traffic matters only if it leads to the right people contacting us.



Rankings matter only if they improve visibility with prospective clients.



Marketing matters only if it produces measurable business results.



## What You Will Own



### Website Management & Optimization



You will help continuously improve our website by:



- Updating and improving website pages and content

- Managing WordPress or a similar CMS

- Improving site speed and mobile performance

- Improving usability and conversion flow

- Identifying and correcting technical SEO issues

- Fixing broken links, indexing problems, page structure, and other technical issues

- Identifying pages that are underperforming and improving them



### Local SEO



You will help us improve local search visibility throughout our service areas.



Responsibilities include:



- Keyword research based on **search intent**

- Identifying keywords that generate calls and inquiries rather than traffic alone

- On-page SEO

- Page titles and meta descriptions

- Header structure

- Internal linking

- Content optimization

- Local service-area optimization

- Monitoring rankings and making adjustments based on performance

- Supporting appropriate citations and local directory consistency



### Landing Pages & Conversion Optimization



You will:



- Build and improve service pages and landing pages

- Develop location-specific pages where appropriate

- Improve calls-to-action and messaging

- Analyze conversion performance

- Make changes based on actual results rather than assumptions

- Help turn website visitors into qualified inquiries



### Google Business Profile Management



You will manage and improve our Google Business Profiles, including:



- Profile optimization

- Posts and updates

- Photos

- Service and business information

- Review monitoring

- Review-response support

- Tracking calls, website clicks, and direction requests

- Monitoring local map visibility

- Identifying opportunities to improve local search performance



### Call-Driven Digital Marketing



We operate a local service business.



That means **phone calls matter.**



You will help us understand which marketing activities actually create qualified conversations.



This may include:



- Supporting Google Ads and other digital campaigns

- Improving ad landing pages

- Assisting with call-tracking systems

- Tracking where calls and inquiries originate

- Reviewing lead quality

- Identifying campaigns and keywords that generate good inquiries

- Identifying campaigns that waste money

- Improving messaging based on actual client conversations and lead quality



## Reporting & Accountability



We expect clear, useful weekly reporting.



We do not want large reports filled with numbers nobody uses.



We want to know:



- How many qualified inquiries were generated?

- How many phone calls were generated?

- Where did those inquiries come from?

- What improved?

- What declined?

- What worked?

- What did not work?

- What did you change?

- What should we do next?



Your weekly reporting may include:



- Calls generated

- Inquiry volume

- Website performance

- Organic search performance

- Google Business Profile activity

- Ranking changes

- Landing-page performance

- Issues discovered

- Work completed

- Next priorities



## What We Value



We are looking for someone who:



- Focuses on **results rather than activity**

- Understands that traffic without conversion has limited value

- Executes without constant supervision

- Thinks in systems and repeatable processes

- Looks for the root cause of problems

- Takes ownership of their work

- Pays close attention to details

- Communicates clearly and honestly

- Is comfortable being measured on real outcomes

- Can explain technical issues in understandable language

- Continues improving rather than simply maintaining what already exists



We especially value someone who is comfortable saying:



**“This is not working. Here is why, and here is what I recommend we change.”**



We would rather identify a problem early and fix it than receive a polished report explaining poor results later.



## Required Experience



You should have hands-on experience with:



- WordPress or a similar CMS

- Local SEO

- On-page SEO

- Google Business Profiles

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics

- Keyword research

- Landing-page optimization

- SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar

- Call tracking or lead tracking



Experience working with a **local service business** is strongly preferred.



Experience with home care, senior care, healthcare, or another phone-driven business is a plus.



## This Role Is NOT For You If



This position is probably not a fit if:



- Your primary experience is social-media posting

- You primarily focus on followers, likes, or impressions

- You rely heavily on spammy backlinks or questionable SEO shortcuts

- You prefer discussing strategy instead of implementing it

- You need constant direction before taking action

- You are looking for a temporary project

- You are an agency or outsourcing company

- You plan to subcontract the work to someone else

- You are currently managing several employers or clients and intend to continue doing so



## Full-Time Commitment



This is a **full-time, dedicated position**.



If hired, this is expected to be your **primary full-time employment**.



We are not looking for someone who is simultaneously working multiple full-time jobs or servicing multiple clients during their scheduled working hours with us.



We want someone who can give the role their professional attention, become deeply familiar with our organization, and grow with the company over the long term.



## Role Structure



- Full-time

- Remote / Virtual

- Direct hire

- Individual applicants only

- No agencies

- No outsourcing teams

- Long-term opportunity

- Consistent working schedule

- Performance-focused

- Opportunity for increased responsibility based on results



## Application Process



We pay attention to how candidates follow instructions.



### Step 1 — Initial Application



Please provide:



1. A short summary of your relevant experience



2. At least **two examples** of websites you have worked on



3. Examples of Google Business Profiles you have managed



4. Examples of SEO work that produced actual calls, leads, or inquiries



5. In **five sentences or less**, answer:



**How would you increase qualified phone calls for a local home care company?**



6. List the marketing, SEO, analytics, and call-tracking tools you regularly use



7. Confirm the following:



**“I am applying as an individual, not as an agency or outsourcing company.”**



8. Also confirm:



**“If hired, this will be my primary full-time position, and I will not work another full-time job or service other clients during my scheduled working hours.”**



### Step 2 — Paid Skills Assessment



Selected candidates may be invited to complete a short **paid practical assessment**.



This is a real-world task designed to evaluate how you think and execute.



You may be asked to:



- Review a service page

- Identify SEO problems

- Identify conversion problems

- Recommend practical improvements

- Rewrite a section of website content

- Provide a short action plan



We use this assessment to evaluate:



- How you analyze problems

- How clearly you communicate

- Whether you prioritize correctly

- Whether you can execute

- Whether you focus on outcomes rather than theory



**We do not ask candidates to perform unpaid work.**



## Final Note



We are building a stable, long-term marketing system.



We are not interested in hacks, shortcuts, inflated numbers, or activity for the sake of activity.



We want someone who can become a trusted part of our team, take responsibility for an important business function, and continuously improve results.



If you take ownership, execute consistently, communicate honestly, and focus on generating qualified inquiries, **this role can grow significantly over time.**



### One Final Instruction



If you have read this entire job posting, include the word:



**GEMINI**



in the subject line or title of your application.



Applications that do not include **GEMINI** may not be reviewed.

title: CURRICULUM TEAM — WRITERS, EDITORS & DIRECTOR: PART TIME / MAY EXPAND
description:
Good Curriculum Does Not Write Itself.



Position Summary

Elorae supports education programs in Korea, including Leaders Academy, where students study English, writing, speech, and competitive debate. The teaching happens live. The curriculum behind it has to be equally strong.



We are building a real Curriculum team, not hiring one generic writer. We want people who can write, edit, organize, and improve educational material across several departments. The priority hire is a Curriculum Director who can set standards, review other people's work, allocate projects, and make the entire team better. We are also hiring strong producers who may specialize in one area.



Current roles include:

• Curriculum Director

• Curriculum Writer, English and ESL

• Curriculum Writer, Debate

• Curriculum Writer, Speech

• Copyeditor



You do not need to fit only one box. If you are genuinely strong in more than one role, say so. Combined roles are welcome.



What This Team Does

Our curriculum is used by real teachers and real students. Work may include lesson plans, student handouts, textbooks, debate preparation materials, speech units, writing prompts, teacher guides, activity sheets, assessment material, and revisions to existing content.



Writers need to understand audience. A worksheet for a younger English learner cannot read like a senior high debate chapter. A speech lesson should not feel like a debate lesson with different labels. Good curriculum is not just grammatically correct. It has a purpose, a level, a sequence, and a classroom reality.



The Curriculum Director role is different. The Director is expected to judge quality, not simply produce pages. You should be able to look at several pieces of work, identify what is wrong, explain the standard, d
 what needs revision, and assign work intelligently across people with different strengths.



Who This Is For

For writing and editing roles, we are interested in people with backgrounds in education, English, ESL, communications, writing, editing, speech, debate, or adjacent fields. Teaching experience is useful because classroom instincts matter. Excellent written English is essential.



For the Curriculum Director, we are especially interested in candidates who have already been responsible for other people's academic output: academic heads, curriculum coordinators, department leaders, senior teachers, editors, school administrators, or similar roles. Years of experience alone are not enough. We need judgment.



Speech and debate experience is a major advantage for the Debate and Speech seats. Korean ability is useful but not required.



A Word About Your Setup

This is remote work. You need your own laptop or desktop, a stable connection of at least 30 Mbps download with acceptable latency, and a workspace where you can focus and join video calls when needed. We work on Korea Standard Time and some overlap with KST business hours is required.



Hours and Payment

These are part-time roles that can expand based on performance and team need. Strong candidates may hold more than one responsibility.



Paid probation begins at 5,000 KRW per hour. The initial ramp is intentionally small so both sides can test fit and real output. Longer-term compensation may shift toward output-based pay depending on the role and the work being produced.



September Philippines Interviews

We will conduct full in-person interview days in Cebu on September 22 and Manila on September 24. Strong applicants who can attend one of those days should make sure their current city is clear in the application. The jobs themselves are remote.



Application Process

Complete the VA application form:





Choose Curriculum and rank the roles that best fit you. Include your CV. If you have curriculum, writing, editing, teaching, debate, or academic work samples, include a portfolio or Drive link. Strong samples matter more than a polished cover letter.



Attentiveness Test

Write "Standards" in your subject line so we know you read the full posting.



Warning

If you use AI to produce generic educational filler and cannot tell whether the result is actually good, this is not the role for you.



If you are applying for Director but your experience is only producing your own work, be prepared to explain how you would evaluate, reject, revise, and allocate the work of others.



If your written English is weak, the application will not advance.

title: Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (Full or partial US hours overlap required)



About OpenCall 



OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.



We are looking for a Quality Assurance Specialist who can rigorously pressure-test our AI agents and ensure they consistently deliver a flawless, human-like conversational experience for the medical and dental practices we serve. 



About the role



As a Quality Assurance Specialist at OpenCall, you are the final line of defense ensuring our AI voice agents sound natural, respond accurately, and navigate complex conversations flawlessly. This is a highly impactful, non-engineering role focused entirely on conversational quality and product reliability.



You will rigorously test both our inbound and outbound phone agents, actively trying to break them by introducing edge cases, unexpected questions, and complex medical scheduling scenarios. You will ensure our AI can handle the unpredictable nature of real human conversations before deployments go live for our medical and dental practices.



Responsibilities



- Conversational Testing: Conduct extensive manual testing of inbound and outbound AI voice agents over the phone, simulating real-world patient interactions, objections, and edge cases.



- Issue Identification & Reporting: Document bugs, prompt failures, unnatural pauses, and conversational dead-ends. You will translate these conversational breakdowns into clear, actionable reports for our engineering and prompt development teams.



- Call Auditing & Grading: Listen to and review call recordings and transcripts from live and test environments to grade AI performance against our strict quality and safety standards.



- Collaborative Iteration: Work closely with Agent Developers and Customer Success Managers to understand customer-specific workflows (like complex dental scheduling rules) and verify that the AI adheres to those precise constraints.



What we're looking for

- Extensive QA or relevant experience: You have 5+ years of experience in quality assurance, conversational design testing, contact center operations, or a highly rigorous analytical role.



- Exceptional English fluency: Because you are evaluating the nuances of spoken English—including tone, register, phrasing, and regional accents—native-level or highly fluent English speaking and listening skills are an absolute requirement.



- Meticulous attention to detail: You notice the subtle difference between an AI sounding "helpful" versus "robotic," and you possess the focus required to run through dozens of conversational flows without letting small errors slip through the cracks.



- Tech-savvy problem solver: You do not need to be an engineer or write code, but you must be highly comfortable working alongside technical teams, navigating internal dashboards, and utilizing modern software tools to log your findings.



Preferred Qualifications

- Full overlap with US business hours (partial overlap is acceptable for the ideal candidate).

- Prior experience testing voice AI, chatbots, LLMs, or working in conversational AI.

- Familiarity with healthcare operations, medical/dental scheduling workflows, or terminology.

You’ll review Amazon listings carefully, including keywords, images, backend data, attributes, variations, dimensions, weights, and size tiers.

Why did sales increase or decrease?



Where are we losing margin?



Which products are underperforming and why?



Are we ordering too much or too little inventory?



What are the biggest risks over the next 30, 60, or 90 days?



We do not want someone who simply reports numbers.



We want someone who can **interpret the data, identify what matters, and recommend what we should do next.**



## Attention to Detail Matters



Amazon is a business where small mistakes can become expensive quickly.



Wrong dimensions, incorrect listing data, inventory mistakes, inaccurate spreadsheets, or missed shipping timelines can directly affect profitability.



You should be naturally **careful, structured, meticulous, and willing to double-check important work before execution.**



## Think Like a Director



We want someone who can gradually operate at a director level.



You should be able to understand where the business is going, what the team should prioritise, what risks management should know about, and which processes need improvement.



You should not need to be told every single thing to do.

If you see an opportunity, propose it.



If something does not make sense, question it.



## Managing People



You’ll manage and coordinate a team of around 6 people.



You should be able to set clear expectations, assign responsibilities, track progress, identify bottlenecks, and hold people accountable without simply chasing for updates.



## AI and Technology



We actively use AI to improve research, listings, analysis, reporting, operations, and project management.



AI is a tool, not a replacement for thinking.



We expect you to use it to work faster and make better decisions while still applying your own judgment and checking the output carefully.

Notion

DataDive

Zoom

AI tools and internal systems



## What We’re Looking For

Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and backend workflows.



Experience with listings, inventory, product launches, and operational processes.



Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spreadsheets and dashboards.



Excellent attention to detail.



Experience managing people and multiple projects.



Strong problem-solving and communication skills.



Commercial awareness and an understanding of how decisions affect revenue, profit, cash flow, and growth.



Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Proactive, open-minded, and comfortable challenging assumptions when something can be improved.



## Working Hours

1-hour break

Remote

44 hours per week



## How to Apply

This role is for someone who can already operate independently and contribute at a senior level.



We’re looking for someone who can become a **key operator in the business: someone we can trust with the numbers, the people, the details, and the bigger picture.**

title: Dating assistant
description:
Dating Concierge & Dating App Assistant



Katie’s Dating Concierge is a premium dating concierge service helping successful, busy men take the work out of modern dating. We handle everything from dating profile management and daily swiping to conversations, screening matches, and arranging dates.



We are looking for a confident, outgoing and socially intelligent woman to join our team long-term.



This is NOT a typical social media or customer service position. You will be communicating with real people on dating apps and with our clients, so you need to be naturally good at conversation, flirting, reading people, and creating genuine chemistry.



What you’ll be doing



Dating App Management



* Manage clients’ dating app profiles and swipe through potential matches.

* Match with women who are a good fit for the client.

* Start and maintain conversations with matches.

* Flirt naturally and confidently while keeping conversations engaging.

* Get to know the women and determine whether they are a good potential match for the client.

* Move conversations toward setting up an actual date.

* Keep track of conversations, matches, and dates.

* Represent the client professionally and in a way that feels natural — the goal is to make the interaction feel authentic, not robotic.



Client Communication



* Communicate directly with our male clients.

* Help onboard new clients and make them feel comfortable using the service.

* Give clients regular updates about their dating activity, matches and progress.

* Answer questions and communicate throughout the dating process.

* Build a comfortable, positive relationship with clients.



Because you will be representing Katie, you should have a warm, confident and slightly flirty communication style with clients as well. Our clients should feel comfortable, appreciated and excited about the service — never embarrassed or awkward about having someone help them with dating.



The ideal candidate



We are looking for someone who:



* Has perfect or near-perfect English and excellent communication skills.

* Has a **clear, natural English accent and is very easy to understand.

* Is confident speaking English — you must be comfortable sending voice messages and speaking with clients.

* Knows how to **flirt naturally and keep conversations fun and engaging.

* Is comfortable talking to both men and women.

* Has strong social skills and can read the tone of a conversation.

* Is outgoing, confident and not shy.

* Understands dating, attraction and modern dating culture.

* Ideally has personal experience with dating apps and understands how people actually communicate on them.

* Can keep multiple conversations organized without losing track of details.

* Is reliable, mature and professional.

* Is comfortable representing someone else online and staying consistent with their personality and communication style.

* Has a good sense of humor and knows how to make people feel comfortable.

* Is looking for a serious, long-term position, not a temporary side job.



Important



Personality is extremely important for this role.



We don't want someone who simply knows how to type messages. You need to understand how to create attraction, how to flirt, how to keep someone interested, how to move a conversation forward, and how to make people feel good talking to you.



If you are naturally charming, confident and social, you will probably enjoy this job.



Schedule



* Tuesday – Saturday

* 5 hours per day

* 25 hours per week

* Working according to Toronto time (EST/EDT)

* Fully remote / online



Pay

$5 CAD/hour



This is intended to be a long-term position for someone reliable who wants to grow with the company.



 Requirements



* Laptop/computer

* Reliable, fast Wi-Fi

* VPN

* Quiet environment where you can communicate professionally

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Ability to send voice messages

* Availability Tuesday–Saturday during the agreed working hours

* Strong attention to detail

* Comfortable using dating apps and communicating online



How to apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous work experience, especially anything related to dating, customer service, sales, social media, communication or online work.

3. Why you think you would be good at this position.

4. A short voice recording introducing yourself in English. We specifically want to hear your English, pronunciation and communication style, so please do not skip this step.



 If you read the entire job description, include the word “king” in your response message.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Dating App Test



We want to see how you naturally flirt and start conversations. Based on the profiles below, write the first message you would send.



1. Dani, 28



“I can’t date Theo Von so I’m here instead”

Graphic Designer

“I’m stronger than I look”

“I can beat you at being early for everything”



Your opener: _______



2. Miri, 26



“Carrot cake defender”

“Message me if you also love… carrot cake”

University of Toronto

Leo



Your opener: _______



3. Ray, 31



Senior Manager in Consulting

“Blindfold me and tell me 60h work week isn’t healthy 🥱”

“First date wish list: Tennis pls play tennis with me 🥹”

Has a dog



Your opener: _______



4. Follow-up



Her profile: “Drinks on me if you guess where I’m from.”



We sent: “How about drinks on me, and you tell me where you’re from? 😊”



She replied: “Lmao great workaround”



What would you reply? _______



We are looking for messages that are short, natural, playful and flirty — something that would genuinely make the person want to respond.



Please do not use ChatGPT or AI for this test. We want to see how YOU communicate.

Potential to grow into a full-time role

4  Month Trial Contract (16 hours/week: Mon–Thu Mornings) 

Working Hours: Must be fully online and available during morning hours (Monday to Thursday). 

Pay Rate: $3.00 USD/hour (~$192 USD / ~3.4M IDR per month approx) PLUS INCENTIVES



 + Performance Incentives Growth Potential: Strong opportunity to expand hours and role scope in 2027 as Intake 2 scales. Location: Remote (Philippines) with room for the role to grow to 25 hours per week in Quarter 2 - 2027.

(Our agency partner handles the core website design,) but you will be the day-to-day engine managing cold B2B traffic, funnels linked to social media, student onboarding, payment administration, student

Key Responsibilities

1. Meta Ads & Pixel Operations

Pixel & Tracking: Configure and verify Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI) events across GHL landing pages and checkout flows. Cold Audience Targeting: Build and manage layered B2B audiences targeting small business owners (e.g., Real Estate, Wellness, Gym Owners). Retargeting Campaigns: Run 14-day retargeting ads for drop-off leads who visited the site but did not apply or book a call. Performance Tracking: Monitor daily Cost Per Lead (CPL) and ad spend efficiency.



2. GHL CRM, Payments & Workflow Management

Automations & Pipelines: Ensure GHL

Course Payment Administration: Monitor payment receipts, track installment/payment plan schedules, and assist with following up on failed charges or billing queries in GHL/Stripe.

Organize student feedback and video testimonials from Intake 1 into reusable GHL media assets for our late-February Intake 2 launch. 



Availability: Must be available online during morning hours, Monday through Thursday (16 total hours/week).



Proven Meta Ads Experience: Experience running B2B or high-ticket lead generation campaigns.



GoHighLevel Proficiency: Deep familiarity with GHL contacts, tags, workflows, calendar automations, membership portals, and basic billing management.



Communication & Support: Clear written English for handling student

Compensation & Incentives



Intake Performance Bonus: Performance-based financial incentives tied to paid enrollment milestones for Intake 1.

2027 Hours Expansion: High performers will have first priority to transition into an expanded, higher-hour role starting in early 2027 for Intake 2.



How to Apply

Submit a brief summary of a past Meta Ads campaign or GHL CRM pipeline you managed. At the very top of your application, write the phrase "The Triple Win" to confirm you read all requirements.

title: Real Estate Video Editor - Long Term Role (Premiere Pro**)
description:
Hey, I'm Louie from Matrx Media, a real estate media company in Auckland, New Zealand. 



We started a year and a half ago and have become very popular in our city. Right now I'm shooting and editing every video myself. I edit to a high standard, and value quality, so have been putting off hiring an editor until now. 

Coming into spring/summer here, I am about to get very busy and need to take some video editing off my plate.



I'm looking for a world-class video editor who uses premiere pro/after effects and loves storytelling. Someone I can send raw clips to and get back edits so amazing that my agents don't even realise it's not me. 



Check out our video editing style here: 



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING:

- Property listing videos (1-2 min, 4K a7siii footage plus drone)

- High-energy reels (1 min) with agents presentation, speed ramps, transitions, custom text, sound design, colour grade

- Sold reels + coming soon reels

- Personal branding videos for real estate agents



WHAT YOU'LL BE SET UP WITH:

- Premiere Pro template, LUTs, MOGRTs

- Music library, brand end cards, sound design library, Higgsfield access

- Agent preferences sheet + reference library of finished videos to match

- Clear edit framework and training in our style (MASCOT)



MUST-HAVES:

- Strong Premiere Pro skills. After Effects would be great too. If you are a Final Cut Pro editor, please do not apply. 

- Portfolio showing your proudest work. It doesn't have to be strictly real estate.

- Strong computer. Must handle 4K footage, export quickly, and run Topaz Video AI for crispy export quality

- Experience with AI video or willingness to be trained (we use Higgsfield)

- Strong ear and passion for sound design

- Good English and grammar. Voice-note briefs will be part of the job, so will need to be understood clearly, and you will learn New Zealand buyer and agent culture over time. (It's a bit more humble tone than USA)

- Fast turnarounds, 24 to 48 hours 



WHAT I REALLY CARE ABOUT:

I need to find an editor who loves studying American and Australian real estate reels and applies the techniques to your own work. Who obsesses over cuts, sound design, color, and awesome text effects, but can also do it at high speed. Who loves groundbreaking editing that makes the audience go WOW! 



HOW IT WORKS:

- Trial: 1 paid test edit ($70 USD), full listing video, 48 hour deadline

- Rates (project-based): $70 USD listing video / $80 USD premium reel / $60 USD personal branding reel / 

  $40 USD ASCOT-only (only finishing up the project) / $30 USD sold and coming soon reels

- Payment: weekly via Wise for the first month, then monthly at end of month from month 2

- Volume: Starting slow then progressing to 5 to 10 videos per week as trust is built and skills are sharpened. You can stack clients.

- Long term: I want someone still with us next year



TO APPLY, SEND:

1. Your showreel or a few real estate video samples (or your wildest work)

2. A casual video introduction of yourself talking. Include your name, where you're from, why we should hire you as our editor, and what you like about our videos

3. Weekly availability + earliest start date

4. Computer specs (GPU and whether it runs Topaz video AI)



Excited to work with you!



Cheers,

Louie
